title: ADVICE ASSOCIATE  (URGENT - FINANCIAL ADVICE EXPERIENCE )
description:
ADVICE ASSOCIATE - FINANCIAL ADVICE INDUSTRY (APPLY IF WITH EXPERIENCE)

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

Salary: AUD$10-$15ph



ABOUT LIFE UNSHACKLED

LifeUnshackled is a platform built to help people reclaim the life they once dreamed of, clients and team alike. We exist because “retire comfortably” is not the goal, freedom is. We bring bold financial strategy and strong follow-through so clients can build real wealth and live life on their terms. You will be joining a growth-minded team that cares about ambition, high standards, and doing work that genuinely helps people unshackle their lives.



ABOUT THE ROLE

The Associate is the operational and relational lead for their assigned clients, acting as the Chief Operating Officer of each client relationship. This role combines precision in data and document management, project management discipline, people and communication skills, hands-on platform execution, and a delegation mindset. Each Associate is responsible for ensuring timely, compliant, and high-quality delivery of financial advice implementation and client outcomes, in coordination with the broader LifeUnshackled team.



FOUR KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITIES

1. The Information Steward

- Custodian of all essential client information and access rights.

- Curate and maintain a “Client Support Pack” with critical data and supporting documents for rapid use in preparing application forms. This includes identity documents (individuals and entities), FATCA, ABNs, ACNs, TFNs, ESAs, bank accounts, wholesale certificates, etc.

- Collect and store tax-related and performance-related documentation (e.g. holding, distribution, loan, rental, annual, market value, tax statements).

- Maintain and enforce the standard client folder structure, file naming conventions, and financial year categorisation so that files are audit-ready at all times.

- Own the client Fact Find end-to-end — keeping it current after every meeting, statement, or client communication, and ensuring it underpins all advice documents as an auditable chain of evidence.

- Monitor and update the real-time client balance sheet, sourcing data from various platforms and reconciling across systems quarterly.

- Ensure adviser access and login credentials are in place and securely managed across all relevant platforms.

- Collaborate with the PSM to standardise and streamline information management.

- Mindset: “Would I be confident this is clean and client-ready at any time?”



2. The Delivery Project Manager

- Leader of accurate client service implementation and delivery timelines.

- Ensure investment transactions are implemented same-day and insurance applications are begun within 48 hours of approval.

- Turn meeting actions and strategic goals into clearly written, trackable tasks — nothing falls through the cracks.

- Own timelines and deadlines — chasing overdue tasks, flagging bottlenecks, and ensuring every task reaches a clear resolution.

- Delegate technical or administrative tasks appropriately while owning the outcome.

- Coordinate closely with paraplanners, the Practice Support Manager, the Principal Adviser, and external professionals.

- Ensure documents and forms are completed correctly, on time, and sent to the right parties.

- Mindset: “What’s needed to move this forward without needing Principal involvement?”



3. The Relationship Anchor

- Point of continuity, context, and connection for each client.

- Understand the needs and preferences of your clients and orchestrate effective service delivery accordingly.

- Be the primary internal advocate and coordinator for your clients.

- Track developments in the client’s personal and financial life.

- Stay across all meeting notes and ensure task systems reflect meetings.

- Notice changes in goals, mindset, or relationships and raise them with the Principal.

- Support the Principal by ensuring they are well-informed before every meeting.

- Ensure the client never has to repeat themselves or chase us for updates.

- Mindset: “What’s shifted for the client that we haven’t yet actioned?”



4. The Compliant Storyteller

- Ensuring each client file tells a compelling and compliant story.

- Keep client files audit-ready with consistent, clear, and updated notes.

- Manage the full post-meeting workflow: consent and transcription, file note generation and review, follow-up
s, and updating the Fact Find with any new information.

- Ensure fact finds, SOAs, ROAs, and client communications are accurate and well-organised.

- Maintain clarity in the chronology and context of advice decisions.

- Highlight progress and transformation in the client’s journey, tying actions back to their goals.

- Ensure documentation not only meets compliance and privacy standards but tells the narrative of value delivered.

- Mindset: “Would this file make sense to an outsider, showing a clear and compliant story of impact?”



PRIORITISATION ORDER

- From a business perspective, your tasks should be prioritised in the following order:

- Cash / investment transacting, including opening of associated accounts and completion of any KYC / onboarding requirements with third parties where this would delay a cash / investment transaction.

- Insurance applications and getting policies into force.

- Preparing meeting summaries and post-meeting
s for your clients, and any sub-10-minute tasks that are directly requested of you by the Principal Adviser.

- Responding to requests made of us by other professionals (we expect fast responses from them and should return the favour).

- Other work pertaining to clients who are in their first 6 weeks with us (including onboarding).

- Other work pertaining to your broader client list, prioritised by the annual fee that they are paying us and any relationship considerations (including preparing their reports / maintaining their client file with current information / supporting loan applications / etc).

- Balance this priority list with approaching deadlines — as deadlines near, the work becomes a higher priority.

- Anything you can’t get to in a reasonable time, just flag it, and we can try to delegate to others or make a business decision to defer that task.



REPORTING & COLLABORATION

Reports to: Practice Support Manager (PSM) for delivery oversight; Principal Adviser for client outcomes.

Collaborates with: PSM, Paraplanner, Admin Assistant, Principal Adviser.



Indicators of Success

- 100% of clients have complete, current documentation and adviser access.

- Tasks are delivered on time with minimal Principal intervention.

- High service ratings and positive feedback from assigned clients.

- Accurate and timely handoff of technical and administrative work.

- Adviser’s administrative workload is reduced for each client in your portfolio.

- Investment transactions executed same-day; insurance applications commenced within 48 hours.

- Demonstrated proficiency across all required platforms.



Expected Behaviour

- Proactive, reliable, and accountable.

- Thoughtful and detail-oriented.

- Able to prioritise and escalate as needed.

- Collaborative, not siloed.

- Focused on both client satisfaction and internal efficiency.



APPLICATION PROCESS

To apply, please submit the following:

• A 2–5 minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you are the best fit for this role

• Your updated CV and LinkedIn profile link

• Names and contact details of three references (2 professional + 1 personal)

To Apply

Your availability and rate expectations

title: Web Developer / Front-End Engineer - Senior Position
description:
Join an Australia Based Digital Marketing Agency Startup!



We’re looking for a Senior Web Developer to join our core team. This isn’t just another dev job, you’ll help shape how the agency runs, build workflows and SOPs, and eventually lead a team of developers while still staying hands on with code each day. The role will start at four days per week (32 hours) and grow into a full-time 40-hour role as the agency expands.





What You’ll Do

• Build fast, clean, modern websites (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React).

• Optimise sites for speed, SEO, and mobile-first performance.

• Contribute to internal projects and client websites.

• Use AI coding assistance tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, etc.).

• Help design processes and prepare to lead a dev team as we grow.



What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of web development experience.

• Strong skills in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), React.

• Familiar with Git and SEO-friendly coding practices.

• Experience using AI coding tools.

• Strong communicator, self-motivated, and comfortable taking initiative.

• Someone excited about stepping into a management role while still committing code daily.



Great to Have (but not essential):

* Strong background in UI/UX design

* Knowledge of SEO and optimisation best practices



Benefits

• Competitive salary paid fortnightly

• 2 weeks paid annual leave, once full time (Calculated pro-rata)

• Paid public holidays (case by case).

• Flexible roster

• Long term stability and growth opportunities





?? Important Note:

We use Hubstaff time-tracking and monitoring software for accountability and transparency.

If you are currently working multiple jobs or plan to juggle this position alongside another full time or demanding role, please do not apply. We are looking for someone who can fully commit their focus and time during agreed working hours.





How to Apply



Ensure that you meet the above criteria and have enough experience to be considered for the role.



Send us:

1. A short intro about yourself.

2. Your CV/resume.

3. Links to your best portfolio work (live sites or GitHub).





Be part of our core startup team and help shape the future of our agency!

title: Seeking a Highly Experienced Front End Web Developer with Design & Figma Skills

title: Instagram Reels Video Editor – Car & POV Niche (Part-Time / CapCut) EN/JP
description:
We are hiring a part-time Video Editor to join our content team. You do not need to manage everything, just deliver high-retention, clean edits using raw footage of car culture, POV photography, and rolling shoots.



Our target audience is primarily English, but most of our raw footage is in Japanese. We need an editor who can comfortably work with Japanese audio, generate auto-captions, and make basic corrections/edits to text so it makes sense in English/Japanese. You do not need to be 100% fluent in Japanese, as long as you can work with Japanese audio and clean up auto-captions accurately.



We do not want over-edited graphics or flashy transition packs. We want simple, fast-paced, high-engagement cuts with clean captions and strong visual hooks.



Key Responsibilities:



Edit raw POV car footage into short, punchy Instagram Reels (delivering a few videos per day).



Structure the first 1-3 seconds to create a strong visual hook.



Use CapCut (or similar) to generate auto-captions, correct basic language errors, and keep text clean and readable.



Execute tight, precise cuts to maintain high viewer retention.



Requirements:



Proficient in CapCut and basic video editing tools.



Bilingual Capability (English and Japanese): Comfortable handling Japanese footage/audio and correcting auto-captions for an English/Japanese audience (fluency is not strictly required, but functional capability is a must).



Proven experience editing short-form content (Reels / TikToks / Shorts).



Strong understanding of retention, pacing, and visual hooks.



An interest in cars, photography, or POV-style videos is a big plus.



Compensation and Hiring Process:



Type: Part-Time (Paid Hourly).



Test Edit: Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief paid test edit.



How to Apply:

Reply with the following details:



Portfolio: Direct links to short-form Reels/TikToks you have edited (showing clean, high-retention edits).



Language Ability: Briefly describe your level of comfort working with Japanese audio/captions.



Hook Insight: In 1-2 sentences, what makes a strong visual hook in a POV reel?



Your Favorite Car: What is your dream or favorite car?



Contact Info: Your WhatsApp number for fast communication.

title: Phone Appointment Setter
description:
We are a UK based lead generation company working with franchise brands across the United States. We generate enquiries from people who are actively looking to invest in and own a franchise business. Your job is to call those people, ask a few simple qualifying questions, and book them into a scheduled appointment with our sales team or the franchise brand's own team.



These are warm inbound leads. They have already filled in a form and asked for information. This is not cold calling.



What you will be doing:



- Calling new leads within minutes of them coming in, plus following up on older leads



- Asking 4 to 5 short qualifying questions from a script (timeline, available capital, location, background)



- Booking qualified people into a calendar slot



- Logging every call outcome and notes in our CRM (GoHighLevel)



- Chasing no shows and rescheduling them



Working hours:



Must be able to work in US Eastern Time working hours. 



36 hours per week. We would prefer someone who can work Monday to Saturday, as Saturdays convert well for this type of lead.



What we are looking for



- Experience in outbound calling or phone appointment setting on US accounts



- Clear, neutral spoken English. Our leads are US based professionals aged 30 to 65 who are considering investing significant money into a business



- Confident on the phone, polite and friendly, comfortable making 30 - 50 dials a day



- Reliable internet, a quiet working space and a high-quality headset



- Experience with using a CRM. GoHighLevel experience is a bonus, but we will train you 



What we offer:



- $1,500 USD per month, paid monthly



- Performance bonus per booked appointment that shows up



- Long term, stable role. We are growing and want someone to stay with us



- Full training, scripts and objection handling provided



How to apply:



Applications without the following will be ignored:



- Record a voice clip of 60 to 90 seconds. In it, introduce yourself, and tell us in a few sentences what experience you have with appointment setting and outbound calling specifically for US clients. 



- Confirm you can work US Eastern time zones, Monday to Saturday.



Shortlisted applicants will do a short interview call before we make an offer.

title: Financial Representative (CPA) – Property Management
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Certified Public Accountant (CPA) to join our growing property management company as a Financial Representative. This position is responsible for overseeing the financial operations of a diverse real estate portfolio, ensuring accurate financial reporting, maintaining compliance, and providing strategic financial guidance to leadership. The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, and experienced in managing multiple entities within a fast-paced property management environment.



Key Responsibilities



- Manage full-cycle accounting for multiple properties and related entities, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, and month-end close.

- Prepare and analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

- Ensure compliance with GAAP, tax regulations, lender requirements, and company policies.

- Oversee cash flow management, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and balance sheet accounts.

- Review and maintain the accuracy of all financial transactions and accounting records.

- Prepare management reports and financial analyses for ownership and executive leadership.

- Collaborate with property managers to analyze property performance and identify opportunities to improve financial results.

- Coordinate with external auditors, tax professionals, and financial institutions.

- Assist with annual budgets, CAM reconciliations, owner distributions, and financial reporting.

- Develop, implement, and improve accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.

- Ensure all financial deadlines are met while maintaining the highest level of accuracy and confidentiality.

- Provide guidance and support to accounting staff and assist with special financial projects as assigned.



Qualifications



- Active CPA license required.

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).

- Minimum of five years of accounting experience, preferably in property management, real estate, or multi-entity accounting.

- Strong knowledge of GAAP, financial reporting, budgeting, and internal controls.

- Experience with property management and accounting software preferred (Yardi, RealPage, QuickBooks, or similar).

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial analysis.

- Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Professional, ethical, and committed to maintaining strict confidentiality.



What We Offer

Paid time off and company holidays.



How to Apply



Please
 hirewise2627gmailcom the following:



Your updated resume

A 1-minute video demonstrating how you applied attention to detail in your previous CPA role



Please note: Applications submitted through OnlineJobs.ph (OLJ) will not be entertained

title: TECHNICAL ONBOARDING MANAGER - $900 P/M + BONUSES (UP TO $1,400 P/M)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Graphic Designer: Children's Music
description:
Thank you for your interest in this role!



This position supports an online curriculum platform for elementary music teachers. The business creates curriculum materials, lesson plans, teaching resources, and professional development for general music educators.



The brand look is clean and friendly, with inspiration from Anthropologie Home, Rifle Paper Co., and Montessori. 



A willingness to quickly learn music terminology, notation, and pedagogy is essential.



If you have a sharp eye for visual hierarchy, balance, and alignment, and take pride in getting the tiny details right, you'll thrive here!



WORK VIBE: 



This position is highly demanding. However, it is imperative to me that all tea
mbers enjoy their work. Expect a positive work environment with extremely high standards.



You will have flexibility in creating your own schedule and completing work during the hours that fit your workflow (often between 10 and 20 hours a week). With whatever schedule works for you, projects will be completed accurately and early, or (at the very latest) by the deadline.



Expect a consistent and transparent schedule for salary increases based on work performance. There is a pay increase each year, and you'll know ahead of time what I'm looking for in order to meet your salary goals. 



__________________________________________



RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Graphic Design and Formatting Execution

Produce polished graphics for social media, website, and teaching materials using established brand templates and guidelines

Apply strong visual hierarchy, balance, and alignment across all design work

Maintain extremely high attention to detail in spacing, color accuracy, typography, and consistency across every piece



2. Curriculum Content Creation and Repurposing

Take raw materials (e.g., video footage) and re-imagine them as different content units (for example, repurposing a video into an Instagram post)

Ensure all content reflects brand voice and visual identity consistently

Apply critical thinking, communication skills, and knowledge of music pedagogy to create and strategically reformat content



3. Educational Illustration & Visual Storytelling

Create original illustrations that support and enhance music education concepts, based on critical thinking and application of music pedagogy knowledge

Example: Develop illustrations that communicate musical ideas, classroom activities, movement directions, game formations, and teaching concepts



4. Collaboration and Implementation

Work collaboratively to implement planned projects

Receive creative direction and translate concepts into finished products

Communicate proactively about progress and any blockers well ahead of deadlines

Ask thoughtful questions and incorporate feedback efficiently



------------------------

Applications with 10 apply points or more will be prioritized. If there is a reason you cannot use 10 points, please explain it in the final paragraph of your application.

 as well as through Online Jobs.

description:

 response test.

, ensuring professional and timely responses. Handle PayPal dispute management and case resolution. Minimize returns through proactive and friendly customer communication. Coordinate with our supplier in China when needed. Adapt to an evolving workload during busier periods.

title: Hiring UGC - AI Video Editors ASAP. Start this week!
description:
Senior DTC eCommerce Video Editor



Remote | Full-Time | UGC, AI Video & Motion Graphics | Meta Ads



About Growing Pains Marketing



Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency that helps DTC eCommerce brands scale through paid social, creative strategy, and direct-response advertising.



We specialize in Meta ads and frequently work with brands in competitive and compliance-sensitive categories, including wellness, supplements, CBD and THC-adjacent products, telemedicine, research compounds, and other restricted markets.



We are hiring a highly skilled video editor who can turn scripts, creative briefs, raw footage, product assets, and AI-generated content into polished advertisements designed to drive purchases.



This is not a basic clip-cutting position.



We need an editor who understands why an advertisement works, how to capture attention within the first three seconds, how to maintain viewer interest, and how to make AI-generated content look and sound believable.



What You Will Create



You will produce short-form advertisements for Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and similar platforms.



Your work may include:



Direct-response video ads

Authentic UGC-style ads

AI spokesperson and talking-head videos

AI-generated B-roll

Product demonstrations

Testimonials and review-style ads

Listicles and comparison ads

Motion-graphics ads

New hooks and creative variations



You will work across multiple DTC eCommerce brands with different products, audiences, offers, and visual identities.



You will collaborate with creative strategists, media buyers, designers, UGC creators, and agency leadership.



Core Responsibilities



Direct-Response Editing

Turn scripts and creative briefs into clear, persuasive advertisements.

Create hooks that capture attention within the first one to three seconds.

Structure videos around customer problems, desires, objections, benefits, proof, offers, and calls to action.

Use pacing, captions, B-roll, visual changes, pattern interrupts, sound design, and motion graphics to maintain attention.

Create meaningful variations instead of only changing fonts, colors, or music.

Edit for purchases and conversions, not views alone.



UGC Editing

Turn raw creator footage into authentic, natural-looking advertisements.

Remove pauses, mistakes, weak lines, and unnecessary sections without making the creator sound unnatural.

Improve footage with slow delivery, poor framing, limited B-roll, or inconsistent audio.

Add relevant product footage, screenshots, reviews, visual proof, captions, and graphics.

Understand when UGC should feel polished and when it should remain casual or imperfect.



AI Video Production

Create believable AI spokesperson and presenter videos.

Generate visually consistent AI B-roll that supports the script.

Create AI voices that sound natural, conversational, and emotionally appropriate.

Correct unnatural pacing, pauses, pronunciation, emphasis, and delivery.

Identify and fix visible AI issues involving lip movement, faces, hands, objects, backgrounds, and scene consistency.

Maintain consistency between generated characters, products, environments, and branding.



Motion Graphics, Captions and Sound Design

Create motion graphics that improve clarity and retention.

Animate hooks, benefits, reviews, offers, statistics, and calls to action.

Create readable, mobile-first captions with a clear visual hierarchy.

Follow each brand’s fonts, colors, and design standards.

Clean and balance dialogue audio.

Mix voice, music, and sound effects appropriately.

Use transitions and effects intentionally without creating unnecessary visual clutter.

Brand and Compliance Accuracy

Follow creative briefs and brand guidelines precisely.

Use approved logos, packaging, product images, fonts, colors, and claims.

Avoid introducing unapproved medical, health, financial, performance, or product claims.

Flag potential compliance concerns before submitting creative.

Check every video for spelling, grammar, punctuation, product accuracy, and safe-area placement.

Ensure the advertisement matches the product, offer, and landing page.



Agency Workflow

Manage projects across multiple client accounts and deadlines.

Follow naming conventions, folder structures, and project-management processes.

Maintain organized project files that another editor can easily open and revise.

Submit editable source files with completed work.

Communicate blockers and deadline risks before they become problems.

Complete revisions quickly without repeating previous mistakes.

Provide clear beginning-of-day and end-of-day updates.

Record Loom videos when needed to explain your work or creative decisions.



Required Experience



You must have:



Professional video-editing experience.

Experience creating direct-response ads for DTC eCommerce brands.

Experience editing authentic UGC advertisements.

Experience with AI video, AI voices, AI spokespeople, or AI-generated B-roll.

Strong knowledge of pacing, storytelling, captions, sound design, color correction, motion graphics, and visual hierarchy.

A strong understanding of Meta ads and short-form paid social creative.

The ability to turn a script and basic asset package into a complete advertisement.

The ability to make AI-generated content look and sound human.

The ability to work across multiple brands without making every video look the same.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong communication, organization, and deadline management.

Comfort receiving direct feedback and completing revisions.

Comfort working with restricted or compliance-sensitive categories.

The ability to provide editable project files and organized source assets.



Editing Software



You must be highly proficient with at least one professional editing workflow, such as:



Adobe Premiere Pro

Adobe After Effects

DaVinci Resolve

Final Cut Pro



CapCut may be part of your workflow, but CapCut experience alone does not qualify someone as a senior editor.



Your submitted work must demonstrate professional editing fundamentals, direct-response judgment, motion skills, and agency-level execution.



Experience with several of the following tools is preferred:



Photoshop

Illustrator

Runway

Kling

Veo

HeyGen

ElevenLabs

ChatGPT

Midjourney



Google Drive

Slack

Asana

Motion

Foreplay

Meta Ad Library

TikTok Creative Center

Nice to Have

Previous DTC eCommerce agency experience.

Experience with wellness, supplements, CBD, telemedicine, research compounds, or other restricted categories.

Experience reviewing creative-performance data.

Experience creating multiple hooks from one core concept.

Experience working directly with UGC creators.

Experience writing or improving UGC scripts.

Experience building reusable editing systems and templates.

Experience reviewing or managing junior editors.

AI prompt-engineering experience.

Graphic-design, product-photography, or creative-strategy experience.

Schedule and Availability



This is a full-time remote position.



You must be available during some U.S. working hours, generally within the following windows:



6:00–9:00 AM Eastern Time

3:00–5:00 PM Eastern Time



Your exact schedule may depend on your assigned shift.



Compensation



$1,500–$2,000 USD per month, depending on experience, skill level, speed, communication, and quality of work.



Higher compensation may be considered for candidates who can:



Consistently produce senior-level creative.

Create advanced custom motion graphics.

Lead AI video production.

Review and improve the work of other editors.

Build editing systems and quality-control processes.

Operate with minimal supervision.

How to Apply

Applications Are Accepted by
 Only



Do not message us through OnlineJobs.ph.



Send your complete application to:







Use the subject line:



Senior Video Editor Application – Your Full Name



Everything must be included in one
.



Your application
 must contain:



Written answers to all application questions below

The exact requested work examples

A Loom video recorded specifically for this position

Your desired monthly compensation

Your availability in Eastern Time



Applications missing the written answers, requested examples, or position-specific Loom video will not be reviewed.



Generic, copy-and-paste, or fully AI-generated applications that do not specifically explain your actual experience will not be considered.



Application Questions



Answer every question directly in the body of your application
.



1. Experience



How many years of professional video-editing and agency experience do you have, and how much of that experience involved DTC eCommerce?



2. Recent Workload



Approximately how many video advertisements did you edit during the last 90 days, and how many brands did you manage simultaneously?



3. Tools and Software



Which professional editing, motion-graphics, AI-video, voice-generation, and image-generation tools do you use?



Which software is your strongest?



4. AI Video Process



Briefly explain your process for making an AI spokesperson, AI voice, and supporting B-roll look and sound natural, consistent, and believable.



5. Direct-Response Judgment



Share one example of an advertisement that performed especially well or poorly.



Explain what happened, what you believe affected its performance, and what you learned from it.



6. Agency Workflow



How do you manage multiple brands, competing deadlines, and urgent revisions?



What do you do when a brief is incomplete or the provided assets are not strong enough?



7. Communication



Rate your written and spoken English from 1–10 and briefly explain your rating.



Are you comfortable communicating through Slack, calls, and Loom videos?



8. Availability



What country and time zone are you located in?



What hours can you consistently work in Eastern Time?



How soon can you start, and do you currently have other clients or employment commitments?



9. Compensation and Fit



What monthly compensation are you seeking in USD?



Why are you specifically interested in working with Growing Pains Marketing?



Required Work Examples

Do Not Send Your Full Portfolio



We do not want your complete portfolio, portfolio website, general Google Drive folder, or a long collection of unrelated work.



Only provide the exact examples requested below:



Two UGC advertisements

Two direct-response advertisements

One motion-graphics example

One AI-assisted video



Choose the examples that best represent your current skill level and are most relevant to this position.



For each example, clearly explain what you personally created, including:



Video editing

Motion graphics

Sound design

Captions

Script changes

AI-generated footage

AI-generated voices

Stock assets

Templates

Any work completed by another person



Applications that only provide a general portfolio or do not include the exact requested examples will not be reviewed.



Required Loom Video



Include a Loom video that is under five minutes and recorded specifically for this position at Growing Pains Marketing.



Generic Loom introductions previously recorded for other jobs, employers, or applications will be rejected.



In your Loom video:



Introduce yourself.

Explain why you are applying specifically to Growing Pains Marketing.

Summarize your relevant DTC eCommerce, direct-response, UGC, AI-video, and motion-graphics experience.

Walk us through the strongest examples included in your application.

Explain exactly what you personally created in those examples.

Explain why your experience makes you a strong fit for this position.



Include the Loom link directly inside your application
.



Do not send the Loom separately. Do not submit a generic introduction video.



Qualified applicants will be contacted by
 regarding the next step.

Edit for purchases and conversions, not views alone.

Remove pauses, mistakes, weak lines, and unnecessary sections without making the creator sound unnatural.

Improve footage with slow delivery, poor framing, limited B-roll, or inconsistent audio.

Understand when UGC should feel polished and when it should remain casual or imperfect.

Hiring DTC - ECOM CREATIVE STRATEGIST

Remote | Full-Time | Meta Ads Focus | Restricted Categories



About Growing Pains Marketing



Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency focused on scaling DTC eCommerce brands through paid social, creative strategy, and direct response advertising.



We specialize in Meta ads and work with brands in competitive and often restricted categories, including wellness, supplements, CBD-adjacent products, telemedicine, research compounds, and other markets where strong creative strategy, compliance awareness, and fast execution matter.



We are looking for a DTC eCommerce Creative Strategist who understands Meta ads inside and out, can turn research into strong creative briefs, and can help launch, monitor, and improve ad creative across multiple client accounts.



This is not just a “make pretty ads” role.



We need someone who can think strategically, understand customer psychology, study competitors, identify winning angles, write strong briefs, collaborate with designers/editors/UGC creators, and help us consistently produce ads that drive purchases.



Role Overview



As our Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for researching markets, developing creative angles, writing briefs, coordinating creative production, uploading/launching ads in Meta, and monitoring performance to identify what is working.



You should be comfortable working across multiple DTC eCommerce accounts and moving quickly without sacrificing strategy or quality.



You will work closely with media buyers, designers, video editors, UGC creators, and leadership to ensure each account has a strong pipeline of new creative.



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy



Develop creative strategies for DTC eCommerce brands running Meta ads.



Research customer avatars, pain points, desires, objections, competitor positioning, reviews, Reddit threads, TikTok trends, Meta Ad Library, Amazon reviews, landing pages, and customer language.



Identify new hooks, angles, offers, formats, and messaging opportunities.



Create clear creative testing plans based on performance data and market research.



Understand direct response principles, buyer psychology, and how to structure ads that convert.



Creative Briefs



Write detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators.



Include hooks, concepts, scripts, visual direction, claims/compliance notes, CTA, product positioning, and references.



Make sure briefs are specific enough that the creative team can execute without confusion.



Provide examples of winning ads, swipe files, and references when needed.



Meta Ads Execution



Upload, launch, and organize ads inside Meta Ads Manager.



Understand Meta campaign structure, ad sets, ad naming conventions, creative testing, and basic performance monitoring.



Know how to read creative performance inside Meta and identify winners, losers, and patterns.



Work with media buyers to understand what creative needs to be tested next.



Monitor active ads and help determine when creative needs to be paused, iterated, or scaled.



Creative Performance Analysis



Review ad performance by hook, angle, format, offer, product, audience, and creative type.



Identify why certain ads are working or not working.



Use performance data to inform future creative briefs.



Track winning patterns across accounts.



Help build a repeatable creative testing system.



Client-Facing Communication



Communicate clearly and professionally with clients when needed.



Present creative strategies, explain why certain angles are being tested, and provide updates on creative direction.



Strong written and spoken English is required.



You must be able to explain your thinking clearly on calls, in Slack, and in Loom videos.



Requirements



You must have experience with DTC eCommerce creative strategy.



You must understand Meta ads deeply, especially for purchase/conversion campaigns.



You must be able to upload, launch, and monitor ads inside Meta Ads Manager.



You must know how to create creative briefs that designers, editors, and UGC creators can actually execute.



You must understand customer research, competitor research, and offer positioning.



You must have excellent written and spoken English.



You must be comfortable recording Loom videos explaining your strategy.



You must be organized, fast, and able to manage multiple accounts.



You must be comfortable working with restricted or compliance-sensitive categories.



You must be available during some U.S. working hours. Between 6-9 am and 3-5 PM depending on your starting shift.



We are not hiring candidates located in North America, or citizens of North America for this role.



Nice to Have



Experience with CBD, supplements, peptides, telemedicine, health/wellness, or other restricted categories.



Experience sourcing or managing UGC creators.



Experience writing UGC scripts.



Experience with tools like Triple Whale, Motion, Foreplay, Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Shopify, or GoHighLevel.



Experience working inside an agency.



Compensation



Base pay: $1,500–$3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and skill level.



Bonus: $100/month per account that maintains KPI on a monthly basis.



Expected account load: 10–20 accounts per month.



If you are able to handle more accounts while maintaining quality, that is a plus.



Hiring Process:



Step 1: Application



You will complete the application questions below and submit examples of your previous work.



Step 2: Level 1 Test



If your application looks strong, we will send you a short Level 1 creative strategy test.



Step 3: Interview



If your Level 1 test is strong, we will schedule an interview.



Step 4: Level 2 Test



Final candidates will complete a paid, more advanced creative strategy test before an offer is made.



Application Requirements



Please answer the questions below carefully. Generic answers will not be considered.



You must also include a Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your experience and walking us through how you think about creative strategy.



Application Questions



Experience

How many years of experience do you have with DTC eCommerce creative strategy?



What types of products or industries have you created ad strategies for?



Have you worked with Meta ads specifically? Explain your experience with campaign setup, ad launching, and performance monitoring.



Creative Strategy

Walk us through your process for going from product research to creative angles.



What makes a strong Meta ad creative for a DTC eCommerce brand?



Share 2–3 examples of creative briefs you have personally created. Include links or screenshots if possible.



Research Process

What sources do you use when researching customers, competitors, and ad angles?



How do you find customer pain points, objections, and buying triggers?



Give an example of a time your research led to a winning ad angle.



Performance Analysis

What metrics do you look at when judging whether an ad creative is working?



How do you d
 whether to kill, iterate, or scale a creative?



Give an example of an ad that failed and what you learned from it.



Communication

This is a client-facing role. How comfortable are you explaining creative strategy to clients?



You MUST include a Loom video under 5 minutes introducing yourself and explaining your creative strategy process.



Rate your spoken and written English from 1–10 and briefly explain.



Availability & Fit

Are you available to work some U.S. business hours?

title: Up to $2000/MO Creative Operations Coordinator
description:
Creative Operations Coordinator



Growing Pains Marketing



Compensation



$1,000–$2,000 USD per month, depending on experience, communication ability, AI fluency, DTC eCommerce agency background, and ability to keep creative production moving independently.



About Growing Pains Marketing



Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency focused on helping DTC eCommerce brands scale through paid social advertising, primarily on Meta.



We work with fast-moving brands in competitive and compliance-sensitive categories, including wellness, CBD-adjacent, research compounds, alternative products, and other restricted markets.



Our creative process moves quickly. We produce ads, test angles, review performance, revise assets, coordinate UGC creators, and launch new creative every week.



We are looking for a highly organized Creative Operations Coordinator who has already worked inside a DTC eCommerce marketing agency and understands how fast creative production moves.



This person must also use AI tools daily to work faster, organize better, summarize information, create checklists, clean up tasks, improve communication, and help keep the creative team moving.



Role Overview



We are hiring a Creative Operations Coordinator to help manage the day-to-day creative production workflow.



This is not a traditional project manager role. This is a hands-on coordination role for someone who can use Asana, Slack, Google Drive, Notion/Sheets, and AI to make sure creative tasks are clear, updated, assigned, followed up on, and completed on time.



You will coordinate between creative strategists, designers, video editors, UGC coordinators, creator sourcers, and media buyers.



Your job is to make sure creative does not get stuck.



You will help answer:



What is being worked on?

Who owns it?

When is it due?

What is blocked?

What needs review?

What needs revision?

What is ready to launch?

Which UGC creators are waiting on outreach, shipment, filming, footage, or revisions?



Your main responsibility is to keep the creative production machine organized and moving.



Must-Have Requirements



You must have:



Previous experience working in a DTC eCommerce marketing agency.

Experience coordinating creative production for paid social ads.

Daily experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Notion AI, or similar tools.

Strong understanding of Meta ad creative workflows.

Experience working with designers, video editors, UGC creators, creative strategists, and/or media buyers.

Strong written and spoken English.

Strong organization and follow-up ability.

Strong attention to detail.

Comfort working in a fast-paced remote agency environment.

Ability to submit a clear Loom video that is 5 minutes or less.



Please do not apply if you have only worked in general admin, local service businesses, corporate project management, or non-eCommerce roles. We need someone who understands DTC eCommerce creative production.



AI Requirement



AI usage is a daily part of this role.



You should already be using AI to:



Summarize Slack threads.

Turn messy notes into clean Asana tasks.

Create checklists.

Draft follow-up messages.

Organize revision notes.

Identify missing information in briefs.

Create daily status updates.

Summarize blockers.

Improve task descriptions.

Build simple trackers.

Prepare weekly creative production summaries.

Improve communication speed and clarity.



You do not need to be an AI developer, but you must be comfortable using AI every day to work faster, think clearer, and keep projects organized.



A candidate who does not use AI daily is not a fit for this role.



What You’ll Own



You will help manage the workflow from creative request to final delivery.



This includes:



Making sure every creative task has a clear brief.

Making sure required assets are attached.

Confirming task owners and due dates.

Keeping Asana updated.

Following up with designers, video editors, UGC coordinators, and creative strategists.

Tracking what is in progress, blocked, waiting for review, needing revision, approved, or ready to launch.

Making sure revisions are tracked and completed.

Escalating blockers before they become major delays.

Making sure creative is submitted for internal review before client review or launch.

Helping the team stay focused on the highest-priority creative work.

Using AI to improve task clarity, summarize updates, and prevent missing details.

Core Responsibilities

1. Creative Production Coordination



You will coordinate the day-to-day creative workflow across multiple DTC eCommerce clients and projects.



Responsibilities include:



Review new creative tasks and confirm they are complete.

Make sure each task includes the script, brief, assets, product details, offer, CTA, brand notes, examples, and deadline.

Confirm who owns each task.

Track daily progress across design, video, AI video, and UGC projects.

Make sure tasks move through the correct stages.

Follow up when a task is stuck.

Make sure deadlines are visible.

Keep the team updated on priorities.

Maintain a clean production calendar or task board.

Help prevent missed deadlines, lost feedback, or unclear ownership.

2. Asana / Task Management



You will help keep Asana clean and accurate.



Responsibilities include:



Create or update creative tasks.

Add owners, due dates, priorities, descriptions, links, and assets.

Use AI to turn messy briefs, Slack threads, or notes into clear Asana tasks.

Make sure task statuses reflect reality.

Move tasks through the correct workflow stages.

Add comments and updates when progress changes.

Track blockers and dependencies.

Tag the correct people when action is needed.

Make sure completed tasks are only closed after final approval or delivery.

Make sure no task sits untouched without explanation.



The goal is that anyone on the team should be able to look at Asana and immediately understand what is happening.



3. Creative Team Follow-Up



You will coordinate with the creative team to make sure everyone knows what they need to do.



You will work with:



Creative Strategists.

Designers.

Video Editors.

AI Video Editors.

UGC Coordinators.

UGC Creator Sourcers.

Media Buyers.

COO / Leadership.



Responsibilities include:



Clarify task requirements.

Confirm priorities.

Follow up on progress.

Ask for updates before deadlines are missed.

Make sure feedback gets to the correct person.

Help resolve confusion between tea
mbers.

Escalate issues to leadership when needed.

Keep communication clear, professional, and direct.

Use AI to clean up unclear communication, summarize feedback, and turn conversations into action items.

4. UGC Production Coordination



You will help manage the UGC creator workflow.



You do not need to personally source every creator from scratch, but you are responsible for making sure the UGC process is organized and moving.



Responsibilities include:



Confirm when a script requires a UGC creator.

Make sure creator requirements are clear.

Track creator selection status.

Confirm outreach has been sent.

Track whether creators accepted, declined, or need follow-up.

Make sure shipping information is collected.

Coordinate with the team for product shipment.

Track product shipment status.

Track creator filming deadlines after product delivery.

Follow up on raw footage submissions.

Make sure raw footage is reviewed.

Track revision requests.

Make sure approved footage is handed off to the video editor.

Update Asana or the UGC tracker throughout the process.

Escalate creator delays, missing footage, shipping issues, or revision problems.

5. Revision and Feedback Tracking



You will make sure revisions are tracked clearly and completed correctly.



Responsibilities include:



Collect revision notes from leadership, creative strategists, clients, or media buyers.

Use AI to organize messy revision notes into clear action items.

Make sure feedback is clear and actionable.

Assign revisions to the correct tea
mber.

Track revision deadlines.

Confirm revised assets are submitted.

Make sure old feedback does not get lost.

Make sure the final version matches the requested changes.

Prevent duplicate, conflicting, or outdated feedback from creating confusion.

6. Creative QA Support



You are not expected to be the final creative approver, but you should help catch basic issues before assets move forward.



You should look for:



Missing assets.

Wrong product.

Wrong offer.

Wrong CTA.

Missing script.

Missing captions.

Incorrect dimensions.

Obvious spelling or grammar errors.

Text that is cut off.

Poor file naming.

Missing links.

Tasks submitted without all required deliverables.

Creative that has not followed the brief.



Over time, this role may grow into more formal creative QA support.



7. Daily and Weekly Updates



You will provide clear production updates to leadership.



This may include:



Daily creative status updates.

Weekly creative production summaries.

List of blocked tasks.

List of overdue tasks.

List of creative waiting for review.

List of UGC creators waiting on shipment, filming, or revisions.

Client-by-client creative output.

Tea
mber workload visibility.

Upcoming deadlines.



You should use AI to help summarize information clearly, but you are responsible for making sure the updates are accurate.



What This Role Is Not



This role is not primarily responsible for:



Writing ad scripts.

Creating creative strategy.

Designing static ads.

Editing videos.

Launching Meta campaigns.

Making final media buying decisions.

Being the sole UGC creator sourcer.

Owning final compliance approval.

Replacing the creative strategist.



You may help with some of these areas if needed, but your main responsibility is coordination, organization, follow-up, accountability, and AI-assisted workflow management.



Required Skills

DTC eCommerce agency experience.

Creative production coordination experience.

Strong understanding of paid social creative workflows.

Daily AI usage.

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent organization.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to follow up without being passive.

Ability to communicate clearly with designers, editors, strategists, and managers.

Ability to keep task boards clean and updated.

Ability to manage multiple projects at once.

Ability to identify blockers early.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced remote team.

Comfortable using project management tools.

Reliable internet and consistent availability.

Preferred Experience

Experience with Meta ad creative production.

Experience working with restricted or compliance-sensitive brands.

Experience coordinating UGC creators.

Experience using Asana, Slack, Google Drive, Notion, Google Sheets, or similar tools.

Experience working with creative strategists, media buyers, designers, and video editors.

Experience creating SOPs, trackers, checklists, or workflow documentation.

Experience using AI to improve team operations.

Tools Used



You should be comfortable using or learning:



Asana — task management.

Slack — team communication.

Google Drive — file and asset organization.

Notion — creator database or internal tracking.

Google Sheets — production trackers.

ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, or similar AI tools — daily workflow support.

Canva — optional, for basic creative review or asset checking.


, Loom, or similar tools — if needed for feedback and review.

Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is:



Experienced in a DTC eCommerce agency.

Highly organized.

Proactive.

AI-fluent.

Detail-oriented.

Clear in written communication.

Strong in spoken English.

Comfortable following up with people.

Comfortable holding people accountable professionally.

Able to manage multiple moving parts.

Not afraid to ask clarifying questions.

Good at spotting missing information.

Good at keeping systems clean.

Calm under pressure.

Reliable with deadlines.

Comfortable working with creatives.

Able to work independently after being trained.

Success Looks Like



You are successful in this role if:



Creative tasks are clearly organized.

Designers and video editors know exactly what they need to work on.

UGC projects are tracked from script to raw footage to final edit.

Deadlines are visible and followed.

Blockers are surfaced early.

Asana accurately reflects what is happening.

Leadership does not need to constantly chase the team.

Revision notes are not lost.

Creative output becomes more predictable.

The team feels more organized and less reactive.

Fewer tasks fall through the cracks.

AI is used daily to improve speed, clarity, and organization.

We will evaluate performance based on:



On-time creative delivery.

Number of overdue creative tasks.

Accuracy of Asana/task updates.

Speed of follow-up.

Number of blocked tasks surfaced early.

Revision tracking accuracy.

UGC production timeline tracking.

Team communication quality.

Leadership confidence in the production workflow.

Work Schedule



This is a remote role.



You must be available during agreed working hours and able to communicate consistently with the team.



Because our team moves quickly, you should be able to provide timely updates, respond to important messages, and keep projects moving without needing constant reminders.



Compensation

title: CRO / Conversion Optimization Manager — Join One of Sweden's Fastest-Growing E-Commerce Companies
description:
We're one of Sweden's largest e-commerce companies and were the fastest-growing of 2025 — now scaling faster than ever, in Sweden and internationally.



This is your chance to join that growth with a role that has real, uncapped earning potential.



You'll earn 3% revenue share on every extra dollar you generate — across a store network doing $30,000–$40,000 USD per day.



Here's the deal: you earn 3% of all extra revenue you drive through our checkout and post-purchase upsells. This store alone does 250–300 orders per day, and we run 10+ more stores. Do great work here, and we'll put you on more of them — which means your earnings can climb fast. We see this as a long-term partnership. The best CRO manager we find could become one of the best-paid CRO managers out there. This is the BEST job opportunity for someone thats highly experienced in CRO.



—



No fixed hours — you work by results, not by the clock:



We don't require you to sit at your desk 8 hours a day. What matters is that everything is optimized: that you're A/B testing here and there, keeping an eye on competitors, and making sure our post-purchase upsells, add-to-carts, and everything in between are dialed in.



Some days a small tweak takes an hour or two — great, then that's all you needed to do that day. Other days, optimizing things properly will take longer. The point is simple: the better everything is optimized, the more you earn. Your time is yours to manage — we care about the results.



—



How your pay works (fully transparent):



We look at each order and check whether Aftersell, ReConvert, or EliteCart were involved in generating extra revenue on it. You get 3% of that extra revenue. Simple and trackable.



—



What you'll do:



Set up and optimize Aftersell from the ground up (we've just started with it)

Continuously A/B test post-purchase and checkout upsells — this is the core of the role

Optimize our post-purchase flows across the store

Split-test offers on our best-selling products

Increase AOV using EliteCart (our current AOV app)

Never stop testing and iterating — always hunting for the next uplift



—



You must have:



Serious, proven CRO experience on Shopify — this is non-negotiable

Deep hands-on experience with Shopify Plus

Strong working knowledge of Aftersell, ReConvert, and EliteCart (or very similar upsell/AOV apps)

A track record of A/B testing and measurable revenue lifts

Total comfort navigating Shopify — you know your way around instantly



—



Details:



Results-based, not hours-based — optimize and test continuously across our stores

Start immediately — we need someone who can begin right away

Pay: 3% revenue share on extra revenue you generate (no base salary — this is a pure performance role with major upside)



—



How to apply:



Tell us about a specific CRO win you're proud of — what you tested, and what the revenue impact was. Mention which upsell/AOV apps you've worked with. We're reading for real experience, not generic applications.

title: Outbound Cold Caller – Australian B2B (Neutral/American Accent Required)
description:
We're an Australian AI automation agency. You'll be cold calling Australian business owners to book discovery meetings for us. Straight outbound dialling — no inbound, no chat support, no admin.



**READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING**



This role calls Australian business owners who hang up fast. You need to sound neutral or American on the phone. If your accent is noticeably Filipino, please don't apply.  We will reject you and it wastes both our time. Be honest with yourself here.



**What you'll do**

- 100+ outbound dials per day using our dialler 

- Work Manila 7am-3pm (Melbourne 9am-5pm). Non-negotiable, these are the only hours that work.

- Book qualified meetings into our calendar

- Log every call outcome in our CRM



**What you need**

- 2+ years outbound calling on a US, UK, or Australian account at a real business 

- Outbound sales or appointment setting specifically. nNot inbound customer service

- Wired internet connection (not WiFi) and a proper USB headset

- Backup power/internet arrangement

- You can handle rejection all day without going flat by 11am



**HOW TO APPLY - follow this exactly or you'll be rejected**



Do not send a CV or a generic intro video. Send a single audio recording, roughly 90 seconds, with these three parts:



1. **(30 sec)** Read this script word for word:

*"Hi, is that [name]? My name's ___, I was just reaching out because we build AI automation systems for Australian businesses to replace admin tasks. Have you looked at anything like that before?"*



2. **(30 sec)** In your own words, unscripted: why would a business owner want to take this call?



3. **(30 sec)** Unscripted: respond to a prospect saying *"I'm not interested, we already have someone doing that."*



Also tell us in your message:

- Which businesses you've worked (company + region)

- Your internet setup (wired or WiFi, speed, backup plan)



Applications without the audio recording will not be read. Applications that only include part 1 will not be read.



**What happens next**

Shortlisted candidates do a live call with us, then a paid trial on real dials before any ongoing arrangement.

title: Business Funding Specialist
description:
Company: Max Credit

Position: Business Funding Specialist

Job Type: Part-Time with opportunity to grow into Full-Time

Location: Remote



About the Role



Max Credit helps entrepreneurs and business owners improve their financial profile and gain access to business funding.



We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Business Funding Specialist to help manage clients through the business funding process.



Your job is to help take a client from funding-ready to funded by reviewing their profile, researching appropriate funding opportunities, preparing applications, tracking results, and keeping the entire funding process organized.



This is not simply a customer service or virtual assistant position. You will be trained on our process, but we are looking for someone who is comfortable working with financial information, following detailed systems, conducting research, and making good decisions.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Reviewing client funding profiles and documentation

* Making sure clients have everything required before funding begins

* Researching banks, credit unions, credit cards, lines of credit, and other appropriate funding opportunities

* Identifying potential funding options based on the client’s profile

* Organizing and preparing funding applications

* Following our funding sequence and internal strategy

* Tracking every application, approval, denial, pending decision, and credit inquiry

* Keeping client records and funding information accurate and up to date

* Updating client progress inside our project management and CRM systems

* Following up when additional documentation or information is needed

* Helping clients handle pending applications or reconsideration when appropriate

* Documenting approval amounts, credit limits, and funding results

* Maintaining organized notes so anyone on the team can immediately understand the status of a client

* Communicating clearly with the team about problems, delays, or opportunities

* Following established SOPs while identifying ways to improve the process



What We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Extremely organized

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable working with numbers and financial information

* Strong at online research

* Able to follow detailed processes without skipping steps

* Able to manage multiple clients at different stages

* Comfortable learning new software quickly

* Good at documenting their work

* A strong written communicator

* Able to think independently instead of constantly waiting for instructions

* Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT for research, organization, and productivity

* Reliable and consistent



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Business funding

* Business credit

* Personal credit

* Credit cards

* Banking or lending

* Loan processing

* Underwriting

* Credit repair

* Financial services

* CRM systems

* GoHighLevel

* Asana

* DisputeFox



Direct business funding experience is preferred but not required if you are highly organized, analytical, coachable, and willing to learn.



What Success Looks Like



A successful Funding Specialist should eventually be able to receive a funding-ready client and manage the operational funding process from beginning to end with minimal supervision.



Applications should be organized.



Client information should be accurate.



Follow-ups should not be missed.



Funding opportunities should be thoroughly researched.



Every application should have a clearly documented status.



The goal is to build a funding operation that is systematic, trackable, and scalable.



Schedule



We are initially hiring this position part-time, with the opportunity to grow into a larger role as the company grows.



You must be available for some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Any experience you have with banking, lending, credit, business funding, credit repair, or financial services.

3. The software and AI tools you are comfortable using.

4. An example of a role where you had to manage a detailed process with multiple steps.

5. Your current availability and preferred working hours.



At the end of your application, include the words “FUNDING READY” so we know you read the entire job description.

title: Social Media Posting VA – Remote iPhone – 7 Days/Week
description:
I’m looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to post and distribute social media content every day.



This is a long-term, part-time position requiring consistent availability seven days per week. You will generally work for approximately 1–2 hours per day, although the first few days may take longer while you learn the system.



All videos, captions, hooks, and posting instructions will be provided. You will not create content from scratch. Your job is to prepare each video as instructed, post it correctly, confirm that it went live, and update our tracking sheet.



IMPORTANT: HOW THE REMOTE PHONE SYSTEM WORKS



This is not a normal social media scheduling position.



You will not post from your own phone or personal social media accounts. Instead, you will control a real iPhone remotely through a private dashboard on your computer.



The iPhone physically stays with our team. When you click, swipe, type, download a video, open an app, or publish a post through the dashboard, those actions happen on the real iPhone in real time.



It is similar to TeamViewer, AnyDesk, Chrome Remote Desktop, or screen mirroring, except you can directly control the phone.



You do not need to be a programmer. However, you must:



• Understand how to navigate an iPhone

• Be comfortable learning new software

• Follow somewhat technical instructions

• Be patient when the remote phone takes a 
nt to respond

• Handle small app or navigation issues without needing every click explained

• Communicate immediately if something is not working



Experience with remote-desktop software, screen mirroring, remote phones, or device-control tools is helpful but not required.



DAILY WORKFLOW



Every day, you will normally be responsible for:



• Posting 1 main video across multiple social media platforms

• Posting approximately 3 Instagram Trial Reels

• Warming up Instagram and TikTok before and after posting

• Confirming that every post went live

• Updating the Google Sheets tracker



The main video will normally be posted to:



• Instagram

• TikTok

• YouTube Shorts

• Snapchat

• Threads

•
 when instructed



Your normal workflow will include:



1. Access the remote iPhone through the provided dashboard.

2. Open the Posting Queue in Google Sheets.

3. Download the assigned video from Google Drive.

4. Import the video into the Edits app.

5. Generate and format the subtitles.

6. Confirm that the text hook, subtitles, and video layout look correct.

7. Export or save the video using the required settings.

8. Complete the Instagram warm-up process.

9. Post the main video to Instagram.

10. Complete the Instagram warm-up process again.

11. Complete the TikTok warm-up process.

12. Post the main video to TikTok.

13. Complete the TikTok warm-up process again.

14. Post the video to the remaining required platforms.

15. Confirm that every post was published successfully.

16. Copy the Instagram post link into the tracker.

17. Mark the main video as posted.

18. Post approximately 3 Trial Reels to Instagram.

19. Confirm that each Trial Reel was published correctly.

20. Mark the correct Trial Reels as posted in the tracker.



You will be given a separate warm-up tool and instructions. Warming up means naturally interacting with content on Instagram and TikTok before and after posting. This is a required part of the job and cannot be skipped.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO



You will not be responsible for:



• Filming videos

• Developing video ideas

• Writing scripts

• Writing captions from scratch

• Performing advanced video editing

• Using your personal social media accounts

• Posting from your own phone



Everything needed for each post will already be prepared.



REVIEW THE ACTUAL POSTING GUIDE



The following guide shows the posting process, including the remote iPhone, Google Drive, Edits, social media apps, Trial Reels, and tracking sheet:







Please review the guide before applying. It will show you what the actual daily job looks like.



If you have read this full description, begin your application with the words REMOTE IPHONE. After reviewing the guide, explain which part of the process you think requires the most attention.



REQUIREMENTS



You must:



• Be available consistently seven days per week

• Have your own computer

• Have stable internet access every day

• Be comfortable controlling an iPhone remotely

• Understand how to navigate iPhone applications

• Have experience posting on social media

• Follow instructions exactly

• Pay attention to captions, covers, text placement, and posting settings

• Double-check your work before publishing

• Keep track of which videos have already been posted

• Communicate immediately when something is wrong

• Be patient with minor remote-connection delays

• Solve simple app and navigation problems independently

• Complete all required warm-up steps

• Be dependable without needing to be reminded every day



Approximately 50 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload is recommended, although a stable connection matters more than extremely fast internet.



PAY



Starting pay is $100 USD per month.



This rate covers the daily workflow described above, seven days per week.



There will be a small paid test before the final hiring decision. The test will confirm that you can control the remote iPhone, follow the guide, prepare and post content correctly, verify your work, and update the tracker.



There may be opportunities for increased pay or additional responsibilities based on reliability, performance, and the growth of the position.



Please do not apply if you are not comfortable with the starting rate or seven-day schedule.



WHEN APPLYING



Please answer the following:



1. What is your full name?

2. What country and time zone are you located in?

3. Are you available seven days per week?

4. What hours are you normally available?

5. Which platforms have you posted on: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat,
, and Threads?

6. Have you used TeamViewer, AnyDesk, screen mirroring, remote-desktop software, or another remote-device system? Please explain briefly.

7. Are you comfortable controlling a real iPhone remotely through your computer?

8. Did you review the provided posting guide?

9. Based on the guide, which part of the process requires the most attention and why?

10. Are you comfortable warming up Instagram and TikTok before and after posting?

11. What is your internet speed?

12. What type of computer do you use?

13. What is your WhatsApp number, including your country code?

14. Why would you be dependable in this position?

15. Are you comfortable with the starting pay of $100 USD per month?



Please answer every question specifically. Generic applications will not be considered.
