title: GOHIGHLEVEL PRODUCTISATION & AUTOMATION EXPERT
description:
GOHIGHLEVEL PRODUCTISATION & AUTOMATION EXPERT



Project-based role with possible ongoing part-time work



We are an established UK martial arts academy looking for a genuinely experienced GoHighLevel specialist to refine and productise our existing CRM and automation system.



Our current GHL system is functioning and used in the business. Nothing is presently known to be broken, and we are not looking for a complete rebuild.



The objective is to turn our working internal system into a professional, well-organised and repeatable done-for-you system that can initially be supplied to other martial arts schools.



WHAT WE ALREADY HAVE



Our GHL system contains approximately 10 active workflows covering areas such as:



• Website enquiries and webhook data

• Programme selection and multiple-child enquiries

• Trial-class booking, confirmation and reminders

• Rescheduling, cancellations and no-shows

• Pipelines and opportunity stages

•
, SMS and WhatsApp follow-up

• Internal notifications and staff tasks

• Membership enrolment and Stripe payments



The system works, but it was originally created for our own business. It now needs to be reviewed, simplified where appropriate, professionally organised and made suitable for repeated deployment.



THE OUTCOME WE WANT



We want a clean master system that:



• Preserves the parts of our existing customer journey that work well

• Uses consistent names, folders and structure

• Replaces hard-coded business information with controlled, configurable values where appropriate

• Clearly separates standard features, client-specific settings and optional custom work

• Can be deployed efficiently into other GHL sub-accounts

• Includes a reliable onboarding, installation, testing and handover process

• Is properly documented and maintainable

• Is ready to demonstrate and market to other martial arts schools



PHASE 1 — PAID AUDIT AND PRODUCTISATION PLAN



The successful applicant will first complete a paid, fixed-price audit. This will also serve as the practical assessment for the larger project.



During Phase 1, you will:



• Map the customer journey from enquiry through trial booking, attendance, enrolment and follow-up

• Review the existing workflows, triggers, waits, conditions, forms, calendars, pipelines, stages, tags, custom fields, custom values, webhooks and integrations

• Identify inconsistent naming, unnecessary complexity, duplicated or obsolete items and business-specific information

• Identify what should be standard across all client accounts, what should be configurable and what must be connected or completed manually for each client

• Assess what can be included in a reusable snapshot and what requires a separate deployment step

• Identify reliability, maintenance and scaling risks

• Recommend the structure for the master system, demonstration account and client-deployment process



PHASE 1 DELIVERABLES



1. A clear customer-journey and system map.



2. An inventory of the important workflows and system assets.



3. A written productisation report explaining:



• What should remain unchanged

• What should be refined or simplified

• What should be standardised

• What should become configurable

• What will require manual setup in each new client account



4. A prioritised Phase 2 implementation plan.



5. A realistic fixed-price quotation and timetable for Phase 2.



Phase 1 is an audit only. No major changes, deletions or rebuilds should be made without written approval.



PHASE 2 — IMPLEMENTATION



If Phase 1 is completed to a high standard, we expect the next phase to include:



• Professionally organising workflows, folders and naming conventions

• Simplifying unnecessary complexity without changing the intended customer journey

• Moving appropriate business-specific information into controlled custom values or configuration fields

• Improving the consistency and professionalism of customer messages, internal notifications and staff tasks

• Creating a clean master snapshot or deployment-ready system

• Creating a fictional demonstration account

• Producing a client-information questionnaire and deployment checklist

• Creating test scenarios and a quality-assurance process

• Documenting manual connections such as domains,
, telephone numbers, calendars, users, Stripe, website forms and webhooks

• Creating administrator instructions, staff guidance and short Loom walkthroughs

• Establishing a change log and a practical method of maintaining the master system

• Completing a pilot deployment into a test sub-account



The exact Phase 2 scope will be agreed after the audit. Please do not quote blindly for the whole implementation before seeing the system.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



This role requires:



• At least three years of regular, hands-on GoHighLevel experience

• Strong experience with GHL Agency accounts and sub-accounts

• Personal experience creating reusable snapshots or systems deployed into multiple client sub-accounts

• Advanced knowledge of workflows, calendars, pipelines, opportunities, forms, tags, custom fields, custom values and communication templates

• Experience separating reusable automation logic from client-specific settings

• Working knowledge of Stripe, webhooks, APIs and website-to-GHL data mapping

• Experience with client onboarding, deployment checklists, testing and documentation

• The ability to understand and improve a system created by somebody else

• Clear written and spoken English

• The ability to explain decisions in plain language to a non-technical business owner



Coding is helpful but not essential. However, you must be comfortable investigating webhook payloads, data mapping and integration behaviour.



This role is not suitable for a beginner, a general virtual assistant or somebody whose experience is limited to basic workflows, completing GHL courses or importing pre-built snapshots.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



• Phase 1: fixed-price paid assignment

• Phase 2: separately agreed fixed-price or hourly work

• Possible ongoing work: approximately 5–10 hours per week after completion

• Initially an internal technical role, not customer-facing

• Occasional availability during UK business hours will be required



All project-specific workflows, snapshots, documentation and materials produced for us must belong to us.



Any paid templates, licensed assets or third-party services must be disclosed before use. Confidential information from other clients must not be shared with us.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the word “DRAGON”. This shows that you have read the advert.



Please answer the following five questions clearly and briefly:



1. How many years have you worked regularly and directly inside GoHighLevel?



2. Describe one GHL system that you personally helped turn from a single-business setup into a repeatable system for multiple client sub-accounts. Include:



• Approximately how many accounts it was deployed into

• One specific example of information that was originally hard-coded and how you made it configurable

• One item that required manual setup or correction after the snapshot was installed

• Approximately how long a normal client deployment took afterwards



3. In no more than five bullet points, explain what you would do during your first five working days on our paid Phase 1 audit.



4. State your fixed-price quotation and completion time for Phase 1. Confirm that your quotation includes all five Phase 1 deliverables listed above.



5. State your hourly rate, weekly availability, earliest start date and availability for occasional meetings during UK business hours.



We value truthful, specific answers. If part of your experience was completed as a team, explain exactly which work you personally performed.



Please do not send:



• A generic cover letter

• A long list of GHL features

• An unpaid technical demonstration

• Confidential client information



We are not asking applicants to complete free work.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to a brief informal conversation about communication and availability. The paid Phase 1 audit—not an unpaid technical test—will be used to assess practical ability before any larger implementation is agreed.

title: Etsy Shop Owner or Etsy VA Needed to Test a New App
description:
I am looking for an Etsy shop owner or experienced Etsy virtual assistant to test Cayana, a new web application for managing Etsy listings.



This is a small, paid product-testing project—not a permanent full-time position. The initial test should take approximately 60–90 minutes. There may be opportunities for further paid testing if we work well together.



IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT



You must either:



• Own and currently manage an active Etsy shop; or

• Regularly manage an Etsy shop for a client and have the shop owner’s permission to connect it to Cayana for testing.



The shop should preferably have fewer than 100 active listings. General knowledge of Etsy without access to a real shop is not sufficient for this particular project.



WHAT THE TEST INVOLVES



You will:



• Create an account and connect an Etsy shop using Etsy’s official authorization process

• Import the shop’s listings into Cayana

• Explore the application while sharing your screen

• Perform a few genuine listing-management tasks

• Make selected low-risk changes and sync them to Etsy

• Explain what you find clear, confusing, useful or disappointing

• Report any bugs or problems you encounter



You will never be asked to share your Etsy password. We will agree in advance which listings and changes are safe to use for testing.



WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



You should:



• Have genuine, recent experience managing Etsy listings

• Be comfortable speaking English during a screen-sharing session

• Be willing to think aloud and give honest feedback

• Have reliable internet and screen-sharing capability

• Be available for a video call during mutually agreed hours



Professional software-testing experience is not required. Authentic Etsy experience and thoughtful feedback are more important.



PAYMENT



The initial payment is $30 for a 60–90 minute session, including a short written summary afterwards.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the word CAYANA and answer all of these questions:



Do you own an Etsy shop, or manage one for somebody else?

What is the public URL of the Etsy shop?

Approximately how many active listings does it have?

Which Etsy tasks do you perform regularly?

Have you used tools such as Vela, eRank, EverBee or other Etsy management software?

If it is a client’s shop, do you have permission to connect it to a third-party application for testing?

Are you comfortable sharing your screen and speaking aloud during the test?

Briefly describe one real listing-management task you would like to try using Cayana.



Please answer the questions individually. Applications that do not demonstrate access to a genuine Etsy shop will not be considered.

title: Client Performance Director 5k/mo+ bonuses
description:
# 



**Company:** Growing Pains Marketing

**Location:** Remote — United States

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Base Salary:** $60k/year USD

**Expected Total Compensation:** $100,000 + USD



## About Growing Pains Marketing



Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency that helps eCommerce brands scale in complex and restricted industries.



Our team includes dedicated media buyers, creative strategists, designers, video editors, tracking specialists, and operations professionals.



We are hiring a Client Performance Director to take ownership of the performance, strategy, health, and retention of a portfolio of client accounts.



This is not a traditional account management role.



You will not be responsible for personally launching ads, designing creative, editing videos, or completing technical implementations.



Your responsibility is to ensure that the right strategy is being executed, performance issues are diagnosed correctly, the internal team remains aligned, and clients clearly understand what is happening with their businesses.



## The Role



The Client Performance Director is the quarterback of the client account.



You will own the overall health and performance of your assigned portfolio.



You must understand each client’s business, monitor results, identify risks and opportunities, coordinate the appropriate specialists, and ensure every account has a clear plan for improvement.



You do not need to be the person pushing buttons inside Meta Ads Manager.



However, you must understand performance marketing well enough to:



* Evaluate campaign strategy

* Interpret advertising and business data

* Diagnose performance problems

* Identify root causes

* Challenge recommendations when something does not make sense

* Communicate complex issues in simple language

* Coordinate the team responsible for solving the problem

* Hold both the client and internal team accountable



Your job is not to personally solve every issue.



Your job is to make sure the correct issue is identified, assigned to the right person, and resolved quickly.



## Key Responsibilities



### Own Client Performance



* Take responsibility for the overall performance and health of assigned client accounts

* Understand each client’s products, offers, margins, customer journey, goals, and performance targets

* Monitor advertising, website, revenue, and customer-performance metrics

* Identify meaningful changes, risks, and opportunities

* Ensure every account has a documented strategy, testing roadmap, and next set of priorities

* Prevent accounts from drifting without a clear plan

* Hold the internal team accountable for executing agreed-upon strategies

* Escalate major risks before they become client emergencies



### Diagnose Performance Issues



Review the entire customer-acquisition journey to determine where performance is breaking down.



Potential issues may include:



* Media-buying strategy

* Creative performance

* Creative fatigue

* Offer strength

* Positioning and messaging

* Landing-page conversion

* Website or checkout problems

* Tracking and attribution

* Average order value

* Customer acquisition cost

* Customer lifetime value

* Inventory or fulfillment

* Account infrastructure

* Customer retention

* Insufficient testing volume

* Unreliable or incomplete data



You must be able to separate symptoms from root causes and recommend the correct next steps.



### Lead Client Communication



* Serve as the primary strategic point of contact for assigned clients

* Lead recurring client calls, performance reviews, and strategy discussions

* Clearly explain results, problems, decisions, and next steps

* Set realistic expectations while maintaining client confidence

* Communicate difficult news directly and professionally

* Avoid blaming clients, media buyers, creative teams, or other departments

* Ensure clients understand what is happening, why it is happening, and what the team is doing next

* Respond to concerns quickly and prevent communication gaps

* Build trusted relationships with founders, executives, and senior marketing leaders



### Coordinate the Internal Team



* Translate client goals and concerns into clear internal action items

* Keep media buying, creative, tracking, operations, and leadership aligned

* Assign clear owners and deadlines for important account actions

* Follow up until issues are fully resolved

* Confirm that approved strategies and deliverables are implemented correctly

* Identify resource constraints before they impact client performance

* Ensure internal recommendations support the client’s broader business goals

* Keep leadership informed about account health, client sentiment, and growth opportunities



### Protect Retention and Growth



* Identify dissatisfaction and account risk before a client d
 to leave

* Build recovery plans for underperforming accounts

* Improve retention through clarity, accountability, strategy, and communication

* Identify opportunities to expand client relationships when additional services would create value

* Help successful clients scale while protecting profitability and operational capacity

* Ensure clients receive measurable value from their relationship with GPM



## What You Will Not Be Responsible For



You will not be expected to:



* Personally manage daily advertising campaigns

* Design static advertisements

* Edit videos

* Write every creative brief

* Build landing pages

* Complete technical tracking implementations

* Handle every operational task yourself



GPM has specialists responsible for execution.



However, you must understand these areas well enough to determine whether the work is strategically sound and producing the intended result.



## Required Experience



* Five or more years of experience in account management, client strategy, performance marketing, eCommerce, or a related role

* Experience owning a meaningful portfolio of client revenue

* Strong understanding of Meta advertising and direct-response marketing

* Experience working with businesses spending significant amounts on paid advertising

* Ability to interpret advertising, website, attribution, and business-performance data

* Experience leading executive-level client calls

* Demonstrated ability to retain and grow demanding client relationships

* Strong strategic thinking, judgment, and problem-solving skills

* Excellent written and verbal communication

* Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through

* Ability to coordinate multiple specialists without micromanaging them

* Ability to remain calm and decisive during performance declines, account restrictions, or client escalations



## Metrics You Should Understand



You should be comfortable interpreting and discussing:



* Revenue

* Advertising spend

* Return on ad spend

* New-customer return on ad spend

* Marketing efficiency ratio

* Customer acquisition cost

* Cost per purchase

* Average order value

* Conversion rate

* Click-through rate

* Cost per thousand impressions

* Cost per click

* Customer lifetime value

* Contribution margin

* Attribution discrepancies

* Creative testing results

* Customer retention

* Repeat-purchase behavior



You do not need to calculate every metric manually, but you must understand what each metric means and how it affects business decisions.



## You May Be a Strong Fit If



* You naturally take ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do

* You care about business outcomes, not simply completing tasks

* You can identify when a client’s offer, website, operations, or sales process is affecting advertising performance

* You can respectfully challenge a media buyer, strategist, client, or executive

* You remain calm when performance declines or an account experiences a serious issue

* You can explain complicated marketing problems in simple language

* You identify problems before the client brings them to your attention

* You are comfortable delivering both good and bad news

* You follow commitments through to completion

* You understand that keeping a client happy is not the same as giving them honest strategic leadership



## You Are Probably Not a Fit If



* You believe account management primarily consists of sending reports and scheduling meetings

* You avoid difficult conversations

* You rely entirely on media buyers to explain account performance

* You cannot interpret advertising or eCommerce data

* You frequently lose track of commitments or deadlines

* You blame other departments instead of coordinating solutions

* You require detailed instructions before taking action

* You tell clients what they want to hear instead of what they need to know

* You wait for clients to identify issues

* You are uncomfortable being accountable for outcomes produced by a broader team



## Compensation



The base salary for this position is:



**$95,000–$110,000 annually**



The exact base salary will depend on experience, strategic ability, previous portfolio ownership, and demonstrated performance.



This role also includes performance-based compensation tied to:



* Client revenue retention

* Portfolio performance

* Client health

* Internal execution

* Account expansion

* Overall portfolio growth



Expected total annual compensation is:



**$125,000–$150,000+**



Exceptional performers who successfully retain, stabilize, and grow a substantial portfolio may earn above the stated range.



This is not a commission-only position. The compensation structure is designed to provide stability while rewarding measurable ownership and performance.



## How Success Will Be Measured



Success in this role will be evaluated based on:



* Gross revenue retention

* Client retention

* Portfolio performance against agreed targets

* Client satisfaction and relationship health

* Speed at which problems are identified and resolved

* Completion of strategic priorities

* Accuracy and clarity of client communication

* Account expansion

* Portfolio growth

* Internal team alignment

* Quality of account recovery plans

* Number of preventable surprises or escalations

* Leadership’s confidence in the health of your portfolio



## Application Instructions



DO NOT MESSAGE ME ON ONLINEJOBS.PH
S ONLY WILL BE REVIEWED

1. Describe an account where performance declined. How did you diagnose the issue, coordinate the response, and communicate with the client?

mbers are responsible for execution?

Establish a structured marketing campaign calendar.

Working Arrangement

Part-time

Remote

Long-term opportunity for the right person

We care more about results, commercial thinking and proven experience than formal qualifications.

title: Long Form Editor Needed!
description:
Most video editors can’t do this.



And that’s not an insult…



It’s just reality.





If your entire skillset is:



- Adding captions

- Zoom cuts every 2 seconds

- Throwing random B-roll on top of talking heads

- Matching words to text like karaoke



This is NOT for you.



Seriously… don’t apply.





Because what we’re building requires a completely different brain.





What we actually need (read this twice):



In short someone who can edit like this:


/watch?v=zIN5dGq5Wjs


/watch?v=D3lhrrXb4WI&t=92s



We’re looking for a long-form video editor who can:



Zoom OUT before they zoom in



Understand the point of a video before touching the timeline



Edit with intention… not decoration



Tie every cut, visual, and pacing decision back to a bigger narrative



This is NOT about making things “more engaging” with noise.



This is about making things more compelling with structure.





Here’s the problem we keep running into…



Editors who come from short-form think:



“More visuals = better edit”



So what happens?



- Every sentence gets a caption

- Every 3 seconds gets a cut

- Every idea gets drowned in unnecessary B-roll



And the final product?



Feels busy… but empty.



Looks edited… but not thought through.



We don’t want that.





What great looks like to us:



You watch a 20-minute video…



And you’re not thinking about transitions or effects…



You’re locked into the story.



Everything feels intentional.



Every cut earns its place.



The pacing breathes.



And when it ends…



You remember the message.





This role is for you if:



You’ve edited long-form content (10+ minutes) like:



- YouTube videos

- Podcast videos



And more importantly…



You think in:



- Narrative arcs

- Retention flow

- Emotional pacing

- Information hierarchy



Not just:



- Effects

- Presets

- Templates





Damaging truth:



This kind of editing is slower.



It takes more thinking.



More rewatching.



More restraint.



BUT…



The end result is 10x more powerful…



And that’s what we care about.





What you’ll be responsible for:



Taking raw long-form footage and shaping it into a cohesive, compelling story



Making editing decisions based on the goal of the video… not habits



Enhancing clarity, flow, and retention without over-editing



Knowing when to add… and when to leave things alone





What we don’t care about:



- Fancy transitions

- Overused editing tricks

- How fast you can pump out clips





What we DO care about:



- Taste



- Judgment



- Restraint



- Storytelling ability



PS. You should be able to handle basic color grading inside DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, or Final Cut.



Nothing crazy…



But enough to make footage feel clean, consistent, and intentional.





How to apply (this is important):



Do NOT send us short-form edits.



We will ignore them.



Instead, send:



2–3 long-form projects (10+ minutes) you’ve edited



And tell us:



- What was the goal of the video?

- What editing decisions did you make to support that goal?

- What did you intentionally choose NOT to do… and why?





If you read this and thought:



“Finally… someone gets it.”



We want to see your work.





If you read this and thought:



“This seems like overthinking editing…”



This is not for you.





If this feels obvious to you…



You’re probably who we’re looking for.



Send your portfolio.

title: Senior Video Editor with Graphics Design background, up to AUD $4,000/mo
description:

We're a marketing agency, hiring one video editor to lead content for one of our brand partners: OzJapwear, an Australian clothing brand.



OzJapwear is Japanese-inspired streetwear built around its community.



You'd own the brand's entire video and design output:



- Short-form ads and social video

- Motion graphics

- Static design

- Occasional long-form recaps



You'll work closely with OzJapwear's founder and our team. You get the goal and the direction, but we want your ideas too.



This is a video editing role first, graphics second. If you edit well and also design, you're exactly who we want. If your background is graphics without strong video, this probably isn't the fit. The first two seconds d
 everything, so we care about hooks and stories, and we want original over generic.



It's a high-output role. Full-time, long-term, remote. We work Australian Eastern time, 2 to 3 hours ahead of the Philippines.



One rule: everything on screen has to be real. Use AI as a tool (captions, transcription, rough assembly, upscaling), but nothing AI-generated ends up on screen. People are buying something physical, so it has to look like what they'll receive.



HOW TO APPLY



We don't want a generic application. We want to see how you'd think about this brand. So:



1. Spend 15 minutes on OzJapwear's Instagram 
 and website (
). Get a feel for how they look, what they sell, and how they talk to their community.



2. Record a short Loom, around 2 minutes, talking about OzJapwear. What you noticed, what stands out to you, what you'd do differently, where you'd take the content. Just talk it through naturally. We want to hear how you actually think about the brand.



3. Show your work. Link two or three examples of real video work, plus one static ad or graphic you designed.



4. Then three quick facts:

- How long a 30-second edit takes you

- Your availability

- How soon you can start

We watch your Loom first. It tells us more than a portfolio can.

title: Executive Operations Manager (Remote – Full Time)
description:
This Isn’t Your Typical Virtual Assistant Role

We’re not looking for someone to simply complete tasks.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys improving businesses.

Someone who spots opportunities.

Someone who sees problems before they happen.

Someone who asks…

“Is there a better, smarter or more efficient way to do this?”

If that sounds like you, please keep reading.



About Us

We are a growing UK-based property company specialising in short-term accommodation.

Alongside our core business, we’re continually improving our systems, exploring new opportunities and embracing technology to help us operate more efficiently.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for an exceptional person to join our leadership team as our Executive Operations Manager.

This is not a standard Virtual Assistant role.

We’re looking for someone who wants to make a genuine impact.



About Me

I’m an entrepreneur based in Liverpool, UK, with over 40 years of experience in property and business.

I believe in giving talented people responsibility, encouraging initiative and rewarding those who consistently add value.

I’m looking for someone who enjoys thinking like an owner, while understanding they are a key member of the leadership team.

I don’t want someone who simply waits for instructions.

I want someone who notices opportunities, brings solutions and helps move the business forward every single day.



Our Approach to AI

Artificial Intelligence is changing the way businesses operate, and we believe those who embrace it today will lead tomorrow.

You don’t need to be an AI expert.

But you must be curious.

You should enjoy learning about new technology, experimenting with AI tools and looking for ways to improve productivity, automate repetitive work and create better systems.

We already use AI in our business and expect this to become an increasingly important part of how we operate.

If you love learning and enjoy finding smarter ways of working, you’ll fit in well here.



Your Responsibilities

Business Operations

? Help oversee the daily operations of our Airbnb business.

? Work alongside our Executive Assistant to ensure priorities are managed efficiently.

? Coordinate with cleaners, maintenance teams and suppliers.

? Monitor operational performance and guest satisfaction.

? Improve systems and document Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

? Identify bottlenecks and recommend better ways of working.

Project Management

? Research new ideas and business opportunities.

? Compare suppliers, software and services.

? Coordinate projects from planning through to completion.

? Ensure deadlines are met.

? Keep the team accountable.

? Report progress and recommend improvements.

Continuous Improvement

This is one of the most important parts of your role.

We’re looking for someone who constantly asks:

? Can this process be improved?

? Can AI help us do this faster?

? Can we automate this?

? Is there a simpler solution?

? Are we solving the right problem?

If you naturally think this way, you’ll thrive here.



The Type of Person We’re Looking For

You are someone who…

? Takes ownership.

? Loves solving problems.

? Thinks ahead.

? Communicates exceptionally well.

? Learns quickly.

? Enjoys responsibility.

? Is organised.

? Has excellent attention to detail.

? Wants to continually improve.

? Enjoys helping businesses grow.

Most importantly…

You anticipate problems before they happen, take ownership of solutions and are always looking for ways to improve the business.



Essential Requirements

? Excellent spoken and written English.

? Minimum three years’ experience in operations, executive support or project management.

? Strong organisational skills.

? Experience using Google Workspace.

? Experience with project management software.

? Excellent internet connection.

? Quiet home office.



Bonus Experience

Experience with any of the following is an advantage:

? Airbnb or hospitality.

? Hostfully.

? PriceLabs.

? AI tools.

? Process improvement.

? Team leadership.

? Recruitment.

? Customer service.

? Spreadsheet reporting.



Salary

Competitive and based on experience.

We’re looking for the right person—not simply the lowest hourly rate.

title: IT Officer

-IT certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent.

-Experience working with Australian or US IT standards and business environments.

-Experience supporting fully remote or distributed teams.



What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is technically capable, responsive, and client-focused. You should be comfortable communicating directly with international clients, working independently, and taking ownership of technical issues from initial troubleshooting through resolution.

title: Recruiter
description:
Recruiter

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | Long-Term



About Change Craft

Change Craft is a growing California-based strategic communications, marketing, and PR agency. We work with government, public health, education, nonprofit, and social impact clients across research, strategy, communications, creative, digital, and operations.

We’re growing quickly, and so is our hiring. We’re looking for a Recruiter to become the day-to-day owner of our recruiting process and a trusted HR partner to company leadership.



About the Role

This is not an administrative recruiting role.

We need someone intelligent, highly organized, and experienced at finding and evaluating great people. You’ll work directly with our President and company leaders to understand what we need, develop recruiting strategies, source candidates, conduct interviews, manage hiring pipelines, and keep searches moving quickly.

We hire across a wide variety of functions, including marketing, communications, creative, research, project management, finance, operations, technology, AI, and administrative roles. Some searches are U.S.-based; others are international.

The right person will understand that good recruiting requires judgment. We don't just need more applicants. We need someone who can identify which candidates are actually worth our time.



What You’ll Do

Recruiting & Talent Sourcing

• Manage multiple active searches simultaneously 

• Develop sourcing strategies based on each position and talent market 

• Source candidates through OnlineJobs.ph, LinkedIn, Upwork, job boards, direct outreach, and other channels 

• Proactively identify strong passive candidates rather than relying exclusively on applicants 

• Review resumes, portfolios, profiles, applications, and work samples 

• Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines 

Screening & Interviewing

• Conduct initial candidate interviews independently 

• Evaluate experience, communication, judgment, professionalism, and overall fit 

• Prepare concise candidate assessments and recommendations for leadership 

• Coordinate interview activities, assessments, references, and subsequent interview rounds 

• Identify inconsistencies or potential concerns before candidates advance 

• Help improve interview questions and evaluation criteria for different positions 



Hiring Operations

• Maintain accurate recruiting pipelines, candidate records, interview notes, and hiring status 

• Coordinate interviews across different time zones 

• Follow up quickly with candidates and internal hiring managers 

• Keep hiring processes moving without requiring constant oversight 

• Maintain job postings and recruiting accounts 

• Track recruiting metrics, hiring progress, and open positions 



HR Partnership

• Work with leadership to clarify job requirements before searches begin 

• Help develop and refine job descriptions 

• Research compensation, titles, qualifications, and talent-market conditions 

• Recommend improvements to Change Craft’s recruiting and hiring processes 

• Support onboarding and other talent/HR initiatives as the role grows 



Required Qualifications

• Professional experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, or HR with significant recruiting responsibility 

• Experience personally sourcing, screening, interviewing, and evaluating candidates 

• Exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal; near-native/native-level professional fluency is essential 

• Strong interviewing and candidate-assessment skills 

• Excellent judgment and ability to distinguish an impressive interview from genuine capability 

• Extremely organized and able to manage multiple searches simultaneously 

• Strong follow-through and responsiveness 

• Comfortable working directly with executives and senior leaders 

• Experience with LinkedIn and online recruiting/job platforms 

• Comfortable learning new recruiting technology and AI-enabled hiring tools 

• Able to work independently and make recommendations rather than waiting for instructions 



Strongly Preferred

• Experience recruiting for a U.S.-based company 

• Experience recruiting for marketing, advertising, PR, consulting, creative, or professional-services organizations 

• Experience recruiting both U.S. and international talent 

• Experience with ATS/recruiting platforms 

• Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, OnlineJobs.ph, Upwork, Indeed, or similar platforms 

• Experience supporting broader HR or People Operations functions 

• Familiarity with AI-assisted sourcing, screening, and recruiting workflows 



Who We’re Looking For

You’re probably a strong fit if you’re the person who can take:

“We need a great project manager who actually understands how an advertising agency works.”

…and turn that into a recruiting strategy without needing someone to tell you every search term, platform, screening question, or next step.

You ask good questions, understand people, notice details, communicate extremely well, and know how to keep a hiring process moving.

Most importantly, you understand that your job isn't to fill interview slots. Your job is to help us make great hires.



How to Apply

Please include:

1. How many years of professional recruiting experience do you have? 

2. What types of positions have you personally recruited for? 

3. Approximately how many hires have you personally managed from sourcing through selection? 

4. Which recruiting platforms and ATS systems have you used? 

5. Have you recruited for U.S.-based companies? If yes, briefly describe your experience. 

6. Please submit a 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and describing the most difficult position you’ve successfully recruited for. 

7. Your expected monthly salary. 



Important: Because communication and interviewing are central to this position, applications who fulfill the video introduction request will be prioritized over those who don’t include a video.

title: Client Support & Booking Virtual Assistant – Tattoo Studio
description:
Do you love tattoos, have excellent communication skills, and genuinely enjoy helping people?



Beautific Studios is a growing tattoo and education studio based in Newport Beach, California. We’re looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Client Support & Booking Virtual Assistant to help manage tattoo inquiries, client communication, quoting, booking support, artist recommendations, and follow-up.



This is not just a general administrative VA position.



You’ll become knowledgeable about our studio, artists, services, pricing, and booking process so you can help guide potential clients from their initial inquiry to the right artist and appointment.



One of our biggest priorities is responsiveness. When someone reaches out because they’re interested in getting tattooed, we want them to receive a helpful response quickly and have someone actively guide them toward the next step.



We’re looking for someone who is naturally organized, communicates warmly and professionally, learns quickly, has good judgment, and is extremely good at following through.



Previous tattoo industry experience is not required. We’ll teach you our quoting and booking systems. However, genuinely loving or being interested in tattoos, art, beauty, or creative industries is a major plus — you’ll spend a lot of your day looking at tattoo designs and helping people bring their ideas to life.



What You’ll Do



Your responsibilities will include:



* Monitor incoming tattoo inquiries throughout your scheduled working hours

* Respond to new inquiries in a warm, professional, and timely manner

* Prioritize quick response times so potential clients aren’t unnecessarily left waiting

* Keep active booking conversations moving by responding promptly when clients reply

* Review client messages, tattoo ideas, and reference photos

* Collect missing information such as size, placement, design details, style, budget, and availability

* Prepare and send tattoo quotes using our established pricing guidelines

* Proactively follow up with potential clients who received a quote but haven’t booked

* Make sure every inquiry has a clear next step and no potential client gets forgotten

* Help clients through the booking, scheduling, and deposit process

* Answer common questions about pricing, appointments, artists, policies, and services

* Learn each artist’s specialties, strengths, experience level, pricing, availability, and preferred types of projects

* Recommend the appropriate artist based on the client’s tattoo idea, style, complexity, budget, preferred timing, and artist availability

* Recognize when a tattoo requires a more experienced or specialized artist rather than simply assigning whoever is available

* Present clients with appropriate artist options when multiple artists could be a good fit

* Offer appropriate alternatives when a client’s preferred artist or appointment time isn’t available

* Help maximize bookings while always prioritizing a good client-to-artist match

* Update client information, inquiries, and lead statuses in our systems

* Keep conversations organized and ensure potential clients don’t fall through the cracks

* Recognize when something falls outside our normal quoting or booking guidelines and escalate it to management

* Assist with additional client-service and administrative responsibilities as needed



What We’ll Teach You



You do not need to know how to quote tattoos or evaluate tattoo designs on your first day.



We’ll train you on:



* Our tattoo pricing and quoting guidelines

* Tattoo sizing and placement considerations

* Different tattoo styles and levels of complexity

* Our artists and their individual specialties

* Artist pricing and availability

* How we determine the best artist for a particular project

* Our booking and deposit process

* Studio policies

* Our client communication standards

* Our lead follow-up process

* When you can make a decision independently and when something should be escalated



Our goal is for you to become increasingly confident and independent as you learn the business.



Eventually, when an inquiry comes in, we want you to be able to understand the request, gather whatever information is missing, determine the appropriate quote or next step, recommend the right artist, and move the client toward booking without needing management to walk you through every inquiry.



Responsiveness Matters



One of the primary reasons we’re hiring for this position is to improve how quickly and consistently we respond to potential clients.



We understand that not every inquiry can be answered immediately or within one hour. However, during your scheduled working hours, responding to new leads and active booking conversations should be a priority.



We don’t want interested clients waiting unnecessarily when someone is available to help them.



Success in this position isn’t simply answering messages — it’s keeping conversations moving.



That means:



* New inquiries are acknowledged quickly during coverage hours

* Client replies don’t sit unnecessarily

* Quotes are sent efficiently once the necessary information is available

* Follow-ups happen consistently

* Every lead has a clear next step

* No qualified inquiry is forgotten because it disappeared into an inbox



We’ll work together to establish realistic response-time and follow-up goals based on inquiry volume and your scheduled coverage.



We’re Looking for Someone Who…



* Has excellent written and spoken English

* Communicates naturally, warmly, and professionally

* Has exceptional attention to detail

* Is reliable, responsive, and consistent

* Understands that speed matters in sales and customer service

* Can prioritize a new potential client while still managing existing conversations and administrative work

* Learns new systems and information quickly

* Can follow detailed instructions and SOPs

* Has good judgment and can make recommendations rather than simply follow a script

* Is comfortable reviewing visual references and identifying important details

* Can learn the strengths and specialties of multiple artists and apply that knowledge to different client requests

* Can balance client preferences with artist fit, pricing, availability, and experience level

* Can manage multiple conversations and follow-ups without losing track of them

* Is comfortable discussing pricing and helping convert inquiries into bookings

* Understands the importance of proactive follow-up

* Knows when to follow an established process and when something needs to be escalated

* Is comfortable receiving feedback and improving quickly

* Takes ownership of responsibilities without needing constant reminders



Previous experience in customer service, sales, appointment setting, lead management, virtual assistance, beauty, salons, med spas, tattoo studios, or another appointment-based business is highly preferred.



You’ll Probably Love This Role If…



You’re someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people and helping them make decisions.



You like organization and get satisfaction from making sure every message is answered and every lead is followed up with.

title: Calling All Accountants & AR Experts
description:
Job overview



We're a fast-growing digital marketing agency looking for a hands-on accountant/bookkeeper who keeps immaculate books and is relentless about getting our money in the door.



This is a doing role, not a supervising one. You reconcile, you code, you invoice, you chase, you close the month. If an invoice is three days overdue, you're already on it — you don't wait to be asked, and you don't get uncomfortable following up until it's paid.



You'll report directly to the founder, who currently does all of this himself.



About us



OPT Digital is a Wellington, New Zealand-based agency helping local trades and home service businesses grow through search — across New Zealand, Australia, and the United States. We've grown quickly into a seven-figure run rate, we operate in three currencies (NZD, USD, AUD), and our goal by the end of 2026 is to be the most trusted name in Local SEO for service businesses in our markets.



One thing that makes us different: we build our own internal tools. Every department at OPT runs on custom dashboards and automations we've built in-house, and finance will be no exception — you tell us what would make your job faster, and we build it with you.



Why this role exists



Right now the founder is doing the reconciliation, the invoicing, the chasing, and the payroll himself. That's a bottleneck, and it's costing us money — invoices go out late, overdue accounts sit longer than they should, and the books lag behind the business.



We need someone to take that off his plate completely and run it tighter than he does.



What you'll own



1. The books. Day-to-day bookkeeping and reconciliation in Xero across bank feeds, Stripe, and other payment platforms. Accurate, consistent transaction coding — every time, not most of the time. Rebuilding and maintaining a chart of accounts that reflects how the business actually operates, so the reporting means something. A disciplined month-end close on a fixed rhythm. The books never fall behind.



2. The cash — this is the part we care most about. Accounts receivable end to end. Invoices prepared, QA'd with the relevant account manager, and out on time. Overdue invoices chased the day they slip — politely the first time, firmly after that, and persistently until the money lands. You track every open account, you know exactly who owes what and how long it's been, and nothing quietly ages out because it was awkward to follow up. You coordinate with account managers so billing disputes get resolved instead of stalling.



We also need payroll for employees and contractors across multiple countries run correctly, on time, and reconciled back to the books.



3. The reporting. P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow reporting at month-end and on demand. Basic cash flow forecasting maintained and reviewed with the founder. Spend tracked across the chart of accounts, with a heads-up when something is drifting — overspend, margin slipping, a cash pinch point coming. When something looks off, you say so early and plainly.



Who this role is for

4+ years in bookkeeping or accounting, ideally for a business (or clients) doing seven figures annually

Deep, current, hands-on Xero expertise — reconciliation, coding, chart of accounts, payroll, reporting. This is non-negotiable

Rock-solid fundamentals: double-entry, accruals, and a genuine understanding of how the numbers connect

You've run payroll yourself, end to end, and reconciled it accurately

You are genuinely comfortable chasing money. You'll be sending follow-ups, making calls, and holding the line on overdue accounts with US, AU, and NZ clients. If collections make you uneasy, this isn't the seat

Clear, confident written and spoken English — you'll be on calls with account managers and, at times, directly with clients about their accounts

Organised and self-directed. You work with a founder, not a manager, and you don't need chasing yourself

Bonus: CPA/CA qualification, NZ or AU accounting/payroll/tax experience, or multi-currency work across NZD, USD, and AUD

What we offer

$1,200–$1,800 USD/month depending on experience — we'll go above the band for a qualified CPA/CA

13th month pay

HMO allowance after your probation period

Paid time off plus paid Philippine public holidays

Fully remote — work from anywhere in the Philippines

Direct access to the founder

Custom tools and automations built around your role

A finance function that is yours to own and shape as we scale

How to apply



We read every application that follows these instructions — and we skip every one that doesn't.



Use the subject line: ACCOUNTS — [Your Name]



Answer these three questions (a few sentences each is fine):



Walk us through your month-end close in Xero, step by step, as you actually run it.

Tell us about the most stubborn overdue invoice you've collected. How long was it outstanding, what did you actually do, and how did it end?

Describe a chart of accounts you've built or restructured. What was wrong with it before, and what did you change?



Optional but strongly encouraged: include a short Loom or video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself and walking us through your Xero experience. Applicants who do this go to the top of the pile.



We're reviewing applications now and will move quickly with the right candidates.

title: Senior Video Editor (YouTube)
description:
WHO WE ARE

NIA Production is a YouTube conglomerate. We own, build, and operate our own channels in-house. Every channel we run is ours.

You can see our work at 



We are 90+ people strong and growing rapidly. Most of our team is hybrid and we hire globally. We move fast. We care about results, and we hire people who think the same way.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

NIA Production doesn't launch channels by guessing what works; we build repeatable systems backed by audience data.

The Experimental Channel Video Editor/Channel Launch Editor exists to develop the editing formula behind every new YouTube channel we launch. Rather than maintaining an established editing style, you'll identify what keeps viewers watching, test competing creative approaches, and turn successful experiments into documented systems that other editors can execute consistently.

Once a channel's editing formula has been proven and handed off, you'll move on to the next experimental channel and repeat the process. Your success isn't measured by how many videos you edit, rather it's measured by how many successful editing systems you create.



HOW THIS ROLE WORKS

Each engagement follows the same cycle:

Discovery and competitor research. Align on goals and audience, tear down 8 to 15 competitor channels (plus any channels outside the niche whose packaging approach could be useful to intergrate), and document which visual patterns work. 

Concept development. Build mood boards and concept options, then commit to one direction.

Pilot videos. Edit benchmark videos to prove the style works in a real edit, not just in mockups.

Style package and template build. Package the style guide and all reusable assets so someone else can run it without you.

Handoff and training. Train the incoming editor, answer their questions, and guide them accordingly through the transition, then move to the next channel.



RESPONSIBILITIES

Research and creative direction. Study the top-performing videos in the niche and work out the editing mechanics behind their retention: how the first 15 to 30 seconds are built, where cuts speed up or slow down, how b-roll and sound design hold attention. Turn that into a direction covering pacing, hook structure, text and graphics, music, and SFX. You pitch this direction and you defend it, with reasoning specific to that niche rather than copying what worked elsewhere.

Niche and channel mastery. Develop a deep, working understanding of both the niche and the specific channel you're building, deep enough to know what will work before testing it. Take what's proven to work elsewhere and adapt it so it fits this channel specifically, and originate new ideas where the niche has a gap, so the channel stands out rather than blends in. 

Pilot editing. Prove the style in real edits. Take raw, unstructured footage and turn it into videos with a strong hook and intentional pacing.

Testing and optimization. Run structured tests between competing approaches, such as two different openings or pacing styles, and use average view duration and retention data to d
 what becomes the standard. When a style is not working, flag it early and propose a new direction instead of repeating what has already failed.

Systemizing and handing off. Build the infrastructure the channel needs to move fast: intro templates, title and caption styles, SFX libraries, transition presets, project templates. Document the formula, train the editor who inherits it, and leave notes detailed enough for them to hold the retention curve without guessing at your reasoning.

Team coordination and delivery. Coordinate with the team, always meet turnaround times, keep up great communication, and be reliable. As we scale, this includes managing and coordinating any additional designers brought on to support volume.

Proactive growth mindset. Be proactive and obsessed with self-improvement, pushing to get better each day.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

This is about the kind of person you are, not just the tasks.

You are not a stylist. You do not have one signature look you apply to everything. A fast-cut challenge channel and a slow cinematic one need different instincts, and you have both.

You are not a maintainer. You like working out the formula, not running it. If you need one channel to settle into, the constant handoffs will wear on you.

You are not an order-taker. You do not just cut what you are handed. You push back on footage that cannot support retention and defend a direction with reasoning.

You are not attached to your edit. Your taste is not the standard. A retention graph can prove you wrong, and you accept it when it does.

You are not a lone wolf. You do not make yourself valuable by being the only one who can recreate your edit. You build so someone else can take over.



REQUIREMENTS



Must-Have:

A portfolio of real, published YouTube edits, ideally across more than one niche or format, since this role will not stay on one type of content.

A track record of turning raw, unstructured footage into compelling videos with a strong hook and intentional pacing, not just polishing footage already shot to a script.

Strong ability to read retention graphs: spotting the exact 
nt viewers dropped off, explaining why, and tying it to a specific editing decision.

Demonstrated versatility, with evidence of adapting your pacing and style across genuinely different content instead of applying one signature style to everything.

The ability to watch a competitor's video and go into full technical detail which editing decisions are driving retention, rather than just saying it feels well edited.

Strong motion graphics ability and working knowledge of AI tools relevant to editing and production.

Ability to manage your own workload across more than one channel without close oversight.

You genuinely enjoy hard challenges. Working out a retention formula from raw, untested footage is difficult and full of dead ends, and you are the kind of person who is drawn to that rather than worn down by it.



Nice-to-Have:

You have launched a channel from its earliest uploads, building the editing style and format from scratch instead of joining an established show.

You have built reusable editing systems (templates, presets, SFX libraries) that other editors actually adopted.

You have trained someone or handed off work before. 



RESULTS



Success in this role is measured by:

Average view duration and retention improve and hold across multiple uploads, not on one standout edit.

Every channel you work on ends up with a documented editing system the team can run without you.

Your tests produce clear, data-backed winners the team can confidently standardize.

You move through channels at a healthy pace instead of staying on one longer than needed.

Your handoff notes are clear enough that another editor understands the reasoning behind every major decision and can hold the retention performance without extra guidance.

You coordinate well with the team and continue to be proactive in surfacing issues that affect the channel’s success.

title: Senior Bookkeeper (Full-Time, Remote)
description:

At Everything Accounted For (EAF), we provide specialized bookkeeping services to businesses across a wide range of industries. Our clients range from small owner-operated companies to multi-million-dollar organizations with over 200 employees.

Our role is to handle the day-to-day financial operations behind the scenes so business owners can focus on growth. We maintain accurate books, perform month-end closes, and provide clear, timely financial reporting that clients rely on to make decisions.

We currently support over 50 clients and continue to grow.



The Role

We are looking for a Senior Bookkeeper who can own client files from start to finish, not just perform tasks.

This role is best suited for someone who:

- Is highly detail-oriented but also understands the bigger financial picture

- Is comfortable working independently and making judgment calls

- Enjoys solving problems and figuring things out

- Has experience managing multiple clients or entities simultaneously

This is not an entry-level role. You should be confident handling full-cycle bookkeeping with minimal supervision and producing clean, accurate books that are ready for accountant review.



Key Responsibilities

Full-Cycle Bookkeeping & File Ownership

- Own the accuracy and completeness of assigned client files

- Manage A/P, A/R, invoicing, and reconciliations

- Maintain and review charts of accounts

- Investigate discrepancies and resolve issues independently

Month-End Close

- Perform and complete month-end close processes

- Reconcile bank, credit card, and loan accounts

- Review financial statements for accuracy and anomalies

- Ensure books are accurate and ready for review at all times

Financial Reporting

- Prepare Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and A/R Aging reports

Payroll & Remittances

- Manage payroll entries and payroll runs

- Process payroll remittances, and WSBC where applicable

Process Improvement

Team Collaboration

- Participate in tea
etings

- Support teammates and contribute to solutions



What We’re Looking For

Experience

- 5+ years of full-cycle bookkeeping experience MANDATORY

- Strong QuickBooks Online experience required

- Experience preparing books for year-end and working with accountants

- Experience managing multiple clients or companies simultaneously is strongly preferred

- Experience in a bookkeeping firm or multi-client environment is an asset

Technical Skills

- QuickBooks Online (MANDATORY)

- Google Workspace, MS Office, Outlook, Dropbox

- Slack and Loom

Core Competencies

We are specifically looking for someone who demonstrates:

- Strong independent problem-solving ability

- Exceptional attention to detail

- Strong organizational and time management skills

- The ability to work efficiently without sacrificing accuracy

- Comfort switching between multiple files and priorities

- Reliability and accountability

- Professional judgment and discretion with confidential data

You should be comfortable:

- Investigating and resolving discrepancies without step-by-step instructions

- Learning unfamiliar processes or tools independently

- Asking thoughtful questions when necessary, but not relying on constant direction



Work Environment

- Fully remote position

- Up to 40 hours per week

- Core hours aligned with PST

- Collaborative team environment using Slack and video calls



Why Join EAF?

At EAF, we value:

- Problem-solving

- Accuracy and speed

- Initiative

- Continuous learning

- Always finding a better way to do things

Our team takes ownership, supports one another, and continuously improves how we work. You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact and help businesses succeed.



How to Apply

Please include the word “EVERYTHING” in your subject line.

In your application, please also include:

1. A brief description of the most complex bookkeeping file you’ve managed

2. The number of clients or companies you handled at one time

3. An example of a bookkeeping issue you identified and resolved independently

Applications that do not include this information may not be reviewed.

title: ON-SITE IN CEBU CITY, EVERY WORKING DAY — Operations / Production Manager, Small Video Editing Team

- Manage the daily workflow: assign work, hold deadlines, keep quality consistent

- Train the team to our style and standards (we provide the system and the scripts)

- Judge editing quality and catch issues before they ship

- Step in and edit yourself when someone is out sick, or when something urgent needs to get done — not a daily requirement

- Manage the workspace, the equipment and attendance

- Report once a day to our team abroad — you are our person on the ground



WHAT WE NEED

- ON-SITE IN CEBU CITY, EVERY WORKING DAY. This is not remote and not hybrid — if you cannot commit to being physically present every working day, please do not apply

- Experience as a team lead, lead editor, or someone who has supervised editors, managed workflow, or done QA/review on a team's output — tell us what that looked like

- Basic-to-solid hands-on video editing ability — enough to judge quality and step in when needed. You do NOT need to be a world-class editor or edit every day. Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects preferred. Tell us what software you use and share a portfolio/reel

- Based in Cebu City, or ready to relocate before starting

- Excellent English, written and spoken

- Comfortable with project management tools (ClickUp, Trello, Asana or similar)

- NBI clearance and at least 2 references we can actually call



NICE TO HAVE

- Recruiting or hiring experience

- Experience with YouTube content

- Experience working inside a seat-lease / BPO facility



WHAT WE OFFER

- PHP 55,000 - 70,000 per month depending on experience

- Full-time, long-term, on-site in Cebu

- You build your own team and grow with the office as it expands



HOW TO APPLY

Put the word CEBU at the top of your reply so we know you read this ad. Then send:

1. A short note about a team or workflow you led, supervised, or did QA on, and how many people were involved

2. Your CV and a portfolio or reel showing your own long-form YouTube editing work

3. Your answer to this question: how would you recruit 4 good video editors in Cebu within 3 weeks?



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a small paid test/trial task before a final decision.



Applications without the word CEBU at the top will not be reviewed.

title: Outbound Appointment Setter / Telemarketer
description:
1LeftSock is a boutique creative marketing agency based in Australia. We help established business owners become impossible to ignore through strategic content, branding and social media. We're looking for a sharp, resilient, full-time outbound caller to run our cold-calling and appointment-setting for Australian business decision-makers.



This is a high-volume, numbers-first role. You won't be expected to "close" anyone on the phone, your job is to make a large number of calls every day, deliver a short, clear pitch, and flag the small percentage of people who want to learn more. We track everything, we pay fairly for results, and we want someone who can do this for the long term, not a 3-week burnout hire.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- 80 outbound dials per day to Australian business owners/decision-makers from lists we provide

- Delivering a short, consistent script and adapting naturally to how the conversation goes

- Logging every call (outcome, notes) in our CRM/spreadsheet in real time

- Booking qualified prospects directly into our calendar for a discovery call

- Reporting daily/weekly numbers - dials, connects, conversations, bookings



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Excellent, clear spoken English an Australian business owner finds effortless to understand on the phone - no reading noticeably from a script

- At least 1-2 years of outbound cold-calling, telemarketing, or appointment-setting experience, ideally for Australian clients

- Thick skin - you'll hear "no" a hundred times a week, we need someone who stays upbeat and consistent through that

- Reliable fibre internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset (or willingness to get one)

- Comfortable working approx. 7:00am-3:00pm Philippine time (9:00am-5:00pm AEST) - a normal daytime shift, no graveyard hours

- Basic comfort with a CRM or spreadsheet-based call log - we'll train you on ours



PAY & STRUCTURE

All amounts below are in Australian Dollars (AUD), paid directly to your Philippine bank account via Wise.



- Independent contractor role - you work directly with the founder, not a call floor

- AUD $650/month fixed base pay

- Plus AUD $50 for every qualified conversation you book AND that shows up - "qualified" means the prospect asked to learn more, not just answered the phone. Uncapped - no limit on how many you can earn per month

- At our target of 5+ qualified conversations/month, that's AUD $900/month total

- Paid fortnightly

- Reviewed after 90 days



For reference: that's approximately PHP 27,900 base + PHP 2,150 per qualified conversation at today's exchange rate (the exact peso amount will vary slightly with each transfer, since it's converted from AUD).



HOW TO APPLY

- Start your application with the word "PINEAPPLE" as the first word - this tells us you read the whole ad

- Send a 60-90 second voice or video recording of yourself explaining why you'd be good at this role

- Include your outbound calling experience, the campaigns/markets you've called for, and your typical results (dials/day, conversion rates) if you track them

- Shortlisted candidates will be asked to do a short paid trial before any full-time offer

title: Digital Ecommerce Coordinator
description:
About Napoleon Perdis Cosmetics:

Napoleon Perdis Cosmetics is a premium beauty brand founded by makeup artist Napoleon Perdis from 1995.

The brand is known for professional-grade colour cosmetics, skincare, and tools, blending artistry with accessible luxury.

It operates across a growing e-commerce , delivering innovative products and colour-led experiences to beauty lovers.



About the job:

Build the Pages. Structure the Content. Drive the Discovery.



Napoleon Perdis' direct-to-consumer channel runs on Shopify. Every product page, landing page, promotion, homepage refresh and on-site experience is built and maintained in-house. Our development agency, 
, supports us on custom development, complex integrations and technical work beyond day-to-day site management.



We are recruiting a Digital Ecommerce Coordinator with responsibility for four connected streams of work: the day-to-day operation of the Shopify site; its ongoing optimisation for search and AI-driven discoverability; the execution of site launches, promotions and campaigns as defined by the Head of Digital through our GTM planning process; and execution support on digital customer experience (CX) and user experience (UX) improvement projects assigned by the Head of Digital.



This is a hands-on execution role with a strong forward-facing focus on discoverability and customer experience. Channel strategy sits with the Head of Digital. Custom development sits with 
. What this role brings is Shopify craftsmanship, structured content thinking, meticulous attention to detail, and the operational precision required to build pages that convert customers today and are readable by the AI models shaping how customers discover brands tomorrow.



What You'll Deliver

- Page Creation - PDPs and landing pages built end-to-end - accurate, on-brand and configured to convert.

- Discoverability - Napoleon Perdis' visibility grown across both traditional search and AI-driven discovery.

- Site Integrity - Accurate content, product data and merchandising across the site, upheld by disciplined pre-launch QA.

- CX & UX Project Delivery - Timely execution of digital experience improvement projects assigned by the Head of Digital.

- Trading Reporting - Weekly on-site performance reporting for the Head of Digital.



What You'll Do

The role is structured across five connected areas of execution.



1. Shopify Site Management

- Own the day-to-day operation of the Shopify site.

- Work directly in the Shopify theme editor, manage metafields, configure collections, deploy content updates and troubleshoot native functionality and installed apps.

- Audit the site regularly for broken links, out-of-stock messaging and any elements not functioning as intended.

- Manage the pre-launch QA process - staging tests before every launch, promotion or major site change.

- Escalate technical issues and site breakage to 
 with clear briefs and reproducible test cases.



2. Page Creation & Launches

- Attend the GTM planning meeting to capture site launch requirements - new products, campaign landing pages, promotional mechanics and timing.

- Build new product detail pages (PDPs) end-to-end - content structure, imagery, copy, cross-sells, inventory sync and structured data - with both customer conversion and AI discoverability in mind from the outset.

- Build campaign landing pages that support marketing activations.

- Configure and launch promotions, discount codes, GWPs and bundles on schedule, and deactivate to plan.

- Merchandise collection pages and the homepage to reflect the current campaign, hero range or trading priority.

- Coordinate launch timing with the Digital Marketing Coordinator to ensure the site is ready when campaigns go live.



3. Discoverability, SEO & Content Optimisation

- Drive ongoing improvements to product pages and landing pages for both traditional SEO and AEO - structured data, schema markup, FAQ-style content, natural language product descriptions and comprehensive metadata.

- Improve site content structure for LLM readability - clear content hierarchies, consistent product information architecture and well-defined entity relationships.

- Execute on-page SEO updates as briefed by the Digital Marketing Coordinator - meta titles, meta descriptions, alt text and structured data.

- Maintain accurate product data across every SKU - pricing, stock, variants, imagery, copy and metadata - in sync with source systems.

- Track how Napoleon Perdis appears in AI-driven answer surfaces and feed insights back to the Head of Digital.



4. Digital CX & UX Improvement Projects

- Support the Head of Digital on digital projects that improve Napoleon Perdis' customer experience and site usability.

- Execute assigned projects end-to-end - spanning areas such as mobile experience, checkout optimisation, personalisation, loyalty integrations, customer service tools and third-party integrations.

- Commission and coordinate custom development work through 
 where projects extend beyond native Shopify capability.

- Test and measure the impact of each project against defined success metrics, and report outcomes back to the Head of Digital.

- Maintain a project register with clear status, next steps, blockers and owner for every active initiative.



5. Trading Reporting & Continuous Improvement

- Extract weekly ecommerce performance data from Shopify analytics and GA4 - revenue, conversion, AOV, top products and on-site behaviour.

- Consolidate performance data into a single, repeatable weekly report for the Head of Digital.

- Flag performance anomalies and wins as they emerge rather than at the weekly review.

- Surface on-site opportunities to the Head of Digital.

- Feed learnings from each launch, promotion and campaign back into the trading and optimisation process.



Qualifications & Skills

- 3–5 years' experience in an ecommerce coordinator or executive role - ideally in beauty, fashion, retail or DTC.

- Deep hands-on Shopify experience - page building, promotions, theme editor, metafields, collections and apps.

- Working knowledge of SEO, AEO and content structuring for LLM readability.

- Confident in GA4; aware of how Klaviyo, Meta Ads and Google Ads drive on-site traffic.

- Comfortable operating inside a structured planning process - able to translate meeting decisions into executed site work.

- Track record of executing digital improvement projects end-to-end, including briefing a development agency where required.

- Strong written English, a clear and concise communication style, and confidence raising issues early.

- Availability to work a minimum six-hour daily overlap with AEST business hours (9am–5pm Sydney time). Start time is flexible. Potential for no. of hours per week to increase post review.

________________________________________

The Paralegal will be responsible for maintaining legal records, tracking important deadlines, coordinating contract administration, supporting compliance activities, and assisting with legal documentation using approved templates and established processes.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, discreet, and capable of working independently while handling confidential information with professionalism and integrity.

________________________________________

Process Improvement & Administrative Support

• Maintain contract, records-management, and compliance workflows.

• Provide regular updates regarding active projects, approvals, deadlines, and outstanding items.

• Support leadership with legal-administrative coordination and document management activities.

• Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.

Familiarity with Supabase or similar backend-as-a-service

Understanding of offline-first architectures and local/cloud data sync

Able to work independently on an existing codebase without documentation

Available for quick turnaround on urgent bugs



Nice-to-have:

Knowledge of iOS PWA-specific issues (home screen apps, SW update behavior)



Compensation



Open to discuss

Text me at

Napoleon Perdis runs its digital marketing through a network of specialist agency partners. This role is responsible for turning those requirements into clear agency briefs, driving delivery against agreed timings, coordinating asset production with our designers, and consolidating weekly performance reporting across every partner.

, maintained in real time.
